mdzod lde'iwin bris/gang gā'i bye ma rnyed kyi gzhir gyur cing mos pa lan re skyes pa'i kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog pa'i sems kyi gnad gsang mthar thug gzhan yod pa la/ da lta rang cag la mngon du gyur pa'i sems pha rol na de 'dra gang yang med do zhes skur ba 'debs pa spong ba dang /4 bdag gzhan snod bcud bde sdug sogs glo bur gyi 'khrul snang ci tsam shar yang sems kyi gnyug ma'i gshis la mnyam pa nyid du shes nas bdag la lhag par chags pa'i skyon bsal te zhen zed kyi gnad dang ldan pa'i dgos pa dang lnga/ 5 zhes pa 'phral gtam tsam mo/ /'phags pa thog med kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bar/ sgrin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin khyod 'dir sogs drangs nas/ nyan rang gis kyang bde gshegs snying po phyogs gcig mthong bar bshad pa/ khyod ltar na/ nyan rang rnams kyang lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtogs pa'i gsang sngags par khas len dgos so zhe na/ nyan rang gis sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid dang gzigs shing / sems kyi nang na gshegs snying yang yod pa'i de tsam la bshad rung ste/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong na chos thams cad mngon sum du mthong mi dgos/ da dung yid bzhin mdzod 'grel du shing rta chen po las g.ya' chod ces gsungs so/ /de bas ches bshad dka' ba zhes pa/ gsar phyogs kyis gshegs snying stong nyid la bzhed pas de ni nyan rang la'ang rtogs pa yod/ de lta na nyan thos kyi stong nyid bstan pa'i sde snod rnams gshegs snying ston pa'i sde snod yin par thal zhe na/nyan rang gis rtogs pa'i stong nyid ni skar ma'i 'od lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba de gnyis mi 'dra'o/ /zhes so/ mi pham chos 101

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/rjes bzhed pa ltar na/ byang sems kyis gshegs snying tshes gcig gi zla ba cha shas mthong ba lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyis yongs rdzogs mthong bas khyad par gsungs pa 'og nas bshad par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ phyi ma'i gnas lugs sogs/ gong du bshad pa'i ye shes rang snang dang sems rang snang gnyis bstan pa'i phyi ma'o/ /phyi ma'i gnas lus sogs sems dang ye shes gang yang min pasarang snang dngos ma yin yang / snang srid dag mnyam du bstan pa rnams kyi dgongasadon gtan la dbab pa'i phyir thamasacad rang snang gi phyogs su bsdus nas bstan pa'o/ /'das pa snang yang 'khor bar chen pa zhes pa'i skabs/ des thag khra sbrul snang bzhin du 'das pa snang yang phyin ci log tu zhen pa ste/ thag khra'i spu nyag re re dang tshogs pa gang yang sbrul du ma song bzhin dbang shes 'khrul ba la sprul snang bzhin/ ye shes dang de'i snang cha la yul dang yul can rang rgyud par snang nas phyin ci log tu zhen pa ni sbyang bya'i gtso bo'o/ /zhesadang / de la lhan skyes kun btagasaganyis skabs/ gter/bskyed byed thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rnam pa gsum gyis thun mong dang mchog gi sems lnga sngon skyes sam da lta skyes pa'o/ /'dir sems lnga dag gi khyad par zhal lung sogs na gsal lo/ tshogs spyod bawo no zhesapa ni/ 'og sgo gtso bor ston pa'o/ /spyir thabs grol lam gyi khyab che chung ni/ grol lam gyi skabasasu lam gyi khog shing mtshan nyid gsum gtso bor bstan pa dang / thabs lam gyi skabs su rang gi dgos chos rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun pa tsam las ma bstan pas grol lam khyab che ba'o/ zhesagasungs/ /mi pham rin po chesathabasagrolagyi lam de gnyis 102

mdzod lde'i:na bris/spyang thabs shes kyi byed pa tsam gtso che chung gi sgo nas bzhag gi gcig shos la gcig shos med pa ma yin la/ gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba la don gcig par shesapar bya'o/ /zhes dang / thabs lam rim gyis pa steng sgo dang cig char ba 'og sgo'i man ngag la bsten par gsungs so/ /༈ gter/yul dbang shes gsum skabs/ yul rags pa dang / dbang po de las phra ba/ rnam shes de las kyang phra bas na de dag la khams gsum zhes brjod de/gdod gzugs gzugs med rnams snga la ltos phyi ma dag phra ba'i khyad par dang mtshungs pas na de dag gi tha snyad spyar ro/ /zhes gsungs/ gter/brda bzhi dang phyag rgya bzhi'i thad/ brda bzhi ni/ sa ma ya st+waṃ dus la bab ces yum gyis bskul/sam ya ho dus yin no zhes lan byin/ slar yang / rā ga ya hoX bdag chags so zhes bskul rā ga yā ma'i chags par bgyi'o zhes lan byin no/ /de ltar brda dang brda lan ma shes na mkha' 'gro'i gnas su song na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsgral nas tshogs 'khor byed par gsungs/ phyag rgya bzhis snyom pa ra zhugs pa ni dza zhes pas lus kyi cha rnams reg hūṃ zhes pas lag pa dang brla 'khyud/ bam̐ zhes pas mkha' gsang dam du sprad/ ho zhes yab kyis gsor yum gyis bskyod pa la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgugs pa/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba 'chang ba/ yan lag phan tshun sdom pa bsdams pa/ yab yum bde bas tshim pa myos pa ste rags pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /dmar cha gyen du drangs pa dgug pa/ rlung gi byed bcing gis stobs kyis gcun pa 'ching ba/ thig le phyir mi ldog pa bsdames pa/ yab yum gyi gsang ba'i rnam shes 103

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/bde ba tshim pa myos pa ste phra ba'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /lhan skyes gnyis 'brel ba zhes pa rten gyi sgo nas yab yum gyi lhan skyes gnyis/ brten pa'i sgo nas yas babs dang mas bstan gyi lhan skyes gnyis so// ༈ spang nas rdo rje dbyings phyug sogs thad/ spang zhes pa mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa spang ba dang / yang na dgug dang bsdams pa mi shes pa spang ba'o/ /rdo rje zhes pa dkyil krung ste de la gsum/ lus rdo rje dkyil krung ni yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /rtsa rdo rje dkyil krung ni/ yum gyi dbu ma'i mar sna yab kyi dbu mar drangs te sad par byas pa'o/ /rlung rdo rje dkyil krung ni/ yum gyi dbu rlung yab kyi dbu mar drangs pa dang / khams rdo rje dkyil krung ni thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa'o/ /rin po ches/ thal 'gyur las/spangs nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa/ /dgug dang bsdam pa ma shes na/ /zhes thabs lam 'og sgo'i skabs rtsa 'ching ba gal che gsungs pa 'di 'bor mi nyan/ zhes gsungs so/ /༈ 'di la dang 'dis rtog zhes pa ni rnam rtog 'dis yul du gyur pa'am rtog pa des bzhag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched la 'di la dang / rnam rtog 'dis rtog par byed pas na 'dis rtog pa zhes so/ /snga ma yul la yul can gyi ming gis btags pa'o// ༈ rtog pa shin tu myur ba ni rnam byang gi dbang po lnga'i nang nas gtso bor shes rab kyis 'jug pa ches myur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mtshan nyid gsum gyi bar gzhan gyis ma chod par yin shin tu thung ba la rtogs gom mthar phyin par byed pa la cig char ba zhes brjod pa yin gyi/ de'i rgyud gyis mtshan nyid gsum gyi snga phyi'i rim pa med pa yin te 'gal me'i 'khor lo bzhin no/ /sbyang sno rang sno 104

mdzod lde'iwin bris/sogs zhal lung na gsal bas ma bris/ gtan tshigs kyi sna rtse tsam zhes pa rtags sgrub sogs rgyas par bkod pa la mi ltos par sbyor ba gcig bkod pa tsam gyis mngon sum du rtogs pa la go dgos gsungs/༈ gter/'dir thun min gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed ces pa/ snang cha sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rtogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ ma dag pa'i zhen snang gtan la phab pas chos nyid gtan la pheb par 'gyur ba'i skabs/ sgyu 'phrul 'di'i skabs kyi snang zhen gcod lugs ni/ rin po ches/ gter chen la gsungs pa/ dpe nyi ma sprin gyis bsgrib pa'i skabs 'od drod dang ldan pa yin kyang / sgrib byed sprin gyis dbang gi 'od zer drod ldan du mi 'char ba yin la/ sprin dang bral tshe 'od zer mtha' dag drod dang ldan par dngos su 'char la/ de yang sngar drod med gsar du drod dang ldan par song ba min par tha snyad kyi yin tshul gsal ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'char gzhi 'od gsal ba'i rig pa nyid tshogs brgyad glo bur ba'i sgrin gyis bsgrib tshe/sems kun gyi gshis ye shes yin par mi snang bar ma dag rang rgyud par snang zhing zhen la/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas snying dbus kyi 'od gsal sad nas mngon du gyur tshe/ de'i ngor sems thams cad 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba ni / dpe gser gling du phyin pa lta bu yin la/ 'di dus yul can thams cad ye shes 'ba' zhig tu shar ba ni/ sngar ye shes min pa gsar du ye shes su song ba min par gnas lugs ji bzhin pa nyid mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /rig pa sad stobs kyis yul can thams cad ye shes su shar/ yul yang ye shes kyi ngor snang bas yul gyi steng na ma dag pa bsal ༄jimed par thams cad dag pa 'ba' zhig 105

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/las med pa myong bas grub pa yin no/ /zhen snang ni rjes thob rgya yan pa'i ngor snang sems rang rgyud la 'khrul rtog tu snang ba 'di tsam las gzhan med pas ngo shes ma shes tsam mam/ rig pa sad ma sad tsam mo zhes gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches/ rnam shesatshogasabargyad chos can dang / de'i rang bzhin chosanyid kyi ye shes gnyis ni/ gcig tha dad gang du'ang khas blang bya min par/ dgongs 'grel las/'du byed khamasadang don dam mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /gcig dang tha dad du yang gang rtogasapa/ /de dag tshul min lta la zhugasapa yin/ /zhesagasungasapa'i lung bzhin/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyisagasungs la/de'i phyir de gnyis tha snyad du gcigam yin te/ semasartogasapa tsam gyisasemasakyi chos nyid ye shes mi rtogs pa dang / chos can dang chos nyid yin pa sogasakyi phyir ro/ /don dam par tha dad min te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pas/ ye shes rtogs dus sems kyang de las tha dad du ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang / ye shes rtogs tshe sems rang grol du 'char ba sogs kyi phyir na'o/ /zhesaso/ /dpal sprul gsungs rgyun las/ snang ba 'di chos can/ lha yin te/ ye shes rang snang yin pa'i phyir/ 'di skabs kyi lha ka dag dang lhun grub zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid yin la/ lha de nyid tshogasabargyad kyi rnam par bzhengs pa'i ye shes rang snang gi cha yin pa'i phyir zhes par go dgos zhes dang / rdzogs chen lugs la snang ba thams cad kyi chos nyid rig stong 'dus ma byas pa de 'bras bu yongs dag lha'i ngo bor dang po ngo shes/ bar du yang yang bskyangs pas rtsal rdzogasapa'i thabs la slob 106

mdzod lde'izin bris/cing / mthar brtan pa thob che sgom stobs kyis snang ba lhar grub pa'am shar ba yin no/ /bshad pa mang pos snang ba lhar mi 'grub kyi dang po sems dang rig pa gnyis su phyes nas rig pa rkyang ded du bskyang ba ni snang ba lhar sgrub pa'i sgo yin/bar du snang lugs 'khrul ba cung zad log nas sems rig gnyis med chu dang rlabs ltar mthong nas sems rig gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrogs ltod nas rtsal gyi 'char sgo la dgag bsgrub mi dgos par gu yangs la blo bde ba'i dbyings kyi nam mkha' la rig pa'i mkha' lding g.yo ba na snang ba lhar 'grub pa'i mgo rtsom pa yang yin/ mthar brtan pa thob pa mthar thug pa na gser gling du sa rdo phal ba btsal spyang mi rnyed pa sems rig chu dang rlabs ltar rtogs par ma zad snang sems kyang desnyar rtogs pa dang gnas lugs dang snang lugs ma bu 'phrod de snang lugs kyi zhakhrul cha dbyings su zad pa na slob lam gyi snang ba lhar sgrub mthar thug yin zhing /mthar rig pa dbyings su 'khyil/ rig gdangasasku dang zhing khams su smin/ rig rtsalarnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su grol ba'i na snang ba lhar grub pa bla na med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ gter longs sku'i smin pa zhes pa'i thad/rgyun mtha' ba des longs sku mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud kyi dri ma ngos zin no/ /sbrulasku'i mos pa zhes pa/ mos spyod pa rnams la'o/ /zhes dang / sku gsum dbyer med kyi cha nas dang / sku gsum gyi ldog cha ma 'dres pa'i cha nas rdo rje dang mngon byang gi sku'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gter bzhed pa gnyis po gang la'ang 'thad mi 'thad kyi cha gnyis zhes pa/ zhen snang med ces pa mi 'thad de shes sgrib phra mo yod pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs min zhes pa 'thade ldan no/ /zhen snang bcad rgyu yod ces 107

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/pa 'thad/ gtan drigs dngos yin gsungs pa mi 'thad/ de gtan tshigs btags pa ba yin no zhes dang / skye med mtshon pa zhes pa/ nam mkha' mthong ba tsam gyis chos rnams skye med du rtogs pa dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan gyi dri ma mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud gyi dri ma ngos zin pa dang / nyi ma'i snying po mthong ba tsam gyi gsal ba'i ye shes mngon sum rtogs pa dang / brag cha thos pa tsam gyis grags stong dbyer med kyi don rtogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshangs dbyangs gcig thos pa'i tshe na rang rang gi mos pa shes nus pa bzhin dngos po gcig nyid mthong ba'i tshe na dgongasadon sna tshogasashes nusaso/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ mi pham rin po ches/ sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi rgyud 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir bstan gyi gtan tshigs thun min pa gsum/ tshad ma bka' gzhung sgra mthun don 'phags/tshig don mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs so/ /dang po chad ma bka' gzhung gi gtan tshigs la bzhi/ rtogs pa bzhi/ dag pa gsum/ mnyam pa bzhi/ bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs rnams so/ /dang po la'ang bzhi/ rgyu gcig pa/ yig 'bru'i tshul/byin gyis brlabs pa/ mngon sum pa'i gtan tshigs so/ /dang po ni/ snang srid kyi chos rnams chos can/ don dam dbyings ye zung 'jug rang byung ye shes su rgyu'i tshul gcig pa yin te/ chos thams cad de'i ngang tshul las ma 'das pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ dbyings las shar ba'i snang ba rnams chos ba na/ des yig 'bru'i tshul gyis kun rdzob sku dang ye shes su snang ba yin te/ dbyings kyi rang bzhin lasam 'das pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis chos can/ phan tshun gcig gis kyang gcig byin gyisabarlabs shing dbyer med pa 108

mdzod lde'iwin bris/yin te/ ngo bo tha dad du ma grub pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ dbyer med pa'i gnas lugs chos can/ blos spyod yul thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ tha snyad kyi blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'byung lnga phung lnga rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnams chos can/ dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid du gnas te/ yum lnga/ rigs lnga/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni / spros pa phyogs re chod pa'i rnam grangs ba'i don dam dang / spros pa mtha' dag chod pa'i rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don gnyis chos(can/ don dam tsam du mnyam pa yin te/ rang bzhin ma sdi/ba pa tsam gyis rab tu phye ba'i phyir/ snang la don byed nus pa yang dag kun rdzob dang / snang yang don byed mi nus pa log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis chos can/ kun rdzob tsam du mnyam pa yin te/ rang ngo'i snang ba dang ldan zhing brtags na dben pa'i phyir/ rnam grangs dang rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam gnyis chos can/ lhag pa'i don dam dkor bdun ngo bo nyid du lhun gyis grub par mnyam ste/ dbyings de ni ye nas ye shes dang gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir/ yang log gi kun rdzob gnyis chos can/ sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du mnyam ste/ snang ba'i gnas tshul ye nas dag pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ snang lugs du mar snang ba'i 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams chos can/ gnas lugs bdag nyid chen por rang byung ye shes gcig tu nges pa yin te/ gnas lugs mthar thugs dpyod pa'i rigs shes kyis de ltar grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sgra mthun don 'phags kyi gtan tshigs ni/ sngags na mi spong bar bstan pa'i dug lnga chorsha/can/109

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/sgra mthun kyang don 'phags pa yin te/ gnyen pos spang ba ma yin la/ de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs kyis ye shes lngar shar ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa tshig don mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid chos can/ spros pa'i rang bzhin cir yang mtha' gcig tu grub pa ma yin te/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa cir yang 'char ba yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di chos can/mtha' gcig tu nges pa med par cir yang 'char ba yin te/ rang gi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa yin pas phyir/ 'di rnams ni rgyu gcig pa la sogs par rigs(pa'i bsgrub pa'i gtan tshigs 'god tshul yin la/ rgyu gcig pa la sogs par gsungs pa'i lugs nyid gtan tshigs su 'god pa ni 'grel ba snga ma rnams ladra'ishes par bya'o/ /dge'o/ /mi pham rin po che'i mdzad pa'i man ngag lta phreng gi mchan 'grel nor bu'ispang mdzod las rgyu gcig par rtogs pa dang / yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang byin gyi rlabs kyi rtogs pa dang / mngon sum par rtogs pa dang / de yang rtogs pa bzhi 'di la rim cig char gnyis kyi bshad pa 'byung yang 'dir rdzogs pa chen po rang byung gi ye shes thig le nyag gcig tu gtan la phebs pas cig char ba ltar du bshad de/ de la rgyu ste rang bzhin nam gzhi gcig par rtogs pa ni chos thams cad don dam par ma skyesapas zhes ma skyes pa'i rang bzhin du so som yin pa dang /kun rdzob tu snang ba bden stong sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du so so ma yin pa ni theg pa chen po thun mong du grags pa dang / ma skyesapa nyid ma skyesabazhin du chu zla ltar sgyu ma dag sna tshogasasu snang zhing rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa dang / sgyu ma ltar snang 110

mdzod lde'iwin bris/ba nyid snang ba bzhin du'ang ngo bo med de ma skyes pa na kun rdzob dang don dam par dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug rang byung gi ye shes ru gcig par rtogs pa ni lung zab mo las grags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /mdor na rang byung ye shes byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni snang stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ 'khor 'das thams cad de'i tshul gcig las mi 'da' ba ni rgyu gcig pa'o/ /yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa ni/ de lta bu'i snang stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin de nyid kyang gdod ma nas sku gsung thugs 'bras bu'i chos su sangs rgyas par bstan pa ste/ de la chos thams cad ma skyes pa ni a yis mtshon te gsung gi rang bzhin/ ma skyes pa nyid sgyu mar snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa ni o yis mtshon te sku'i rang bzhin/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rig pa sgyu ma'i ye shes mtha' dbus med pa ni oṃ gyis mtshon te thugs kyi rang bzhin du rtogasapa'o/ /de yang gdod nas snang stong zung 'jug gi ye shes de la bsal bzhag gi bri gang nam yang med cing / de nyid rang bzhin rnam par dag pas 'khor ba ye sangs chen po yin la/ de nyid kyi rol ba ni gdod nas dkyil 'khor gsum du gnas pa yin par ni yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'o/ /byin gyi brlabs kyi rtogs pa ni/ rtogs pa rnam pa gnyis po de'i mthu dang byin rlabs shes pa ste/ dper na ras dkar po la dmar po byin gyis rlabs pa'i mthu btsod la yod pa bzhin du/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs pa'i mthu yang rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul gyi mthus byin gyis rlobs par shes shing rtogasapa'o/ /de la chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin mod kyi rtogs pa gnyis dang mi ldan pa rnams la/ des 111

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/phan 'dogs par mi 'gyur la/ de gnyis dang ldan na ni phan thog par snang bar 'gyur bas/ rtogs pa gnyis kyi mthus chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs pa ltar snang bar 'gyur bas byin gyis rlobs par rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon sum par rtogs pa ni/ spyi dbang po mngon sum sogs yod kyang 'dir shes rab kyi dbang po'i mngon sum ste/ de yang so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid la go bar bya ste/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par gnas pa de yang yin zhes pa'i lung dang bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang 'gal ba'ang ma yin pa ste/ dper na bsreg bcad brdar bas gser yin min/ zon yod med gser bzang ngan shes pa bzhin du/ lung gis spyi la mi 'khrul/ lung la drang nges ldem dgongs sna tshogs pa la man ngag gis de'i skyon bsal bas yid ches lung dang man ngag yod kyang tshig tsam gyis sgra phyir 'brang ba'i blo'i gting du nyams su ma lon pa yang yod pas/ lung dang man ngag gi tshig tsam la brten pa'ang ma yin par so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab bam rang gi rig pas blo'i gting du yid ches pas mngon sum du rtogs pa'o/ /zhes 'dis ni lung gi don spyi phyin ci ma log pa shes par 'gyur la/ man ngag gis lung gi dgongs pa gzhan du 'dren pa gcod cing shes rab kyis mngon sum du rtogs pas thob pa tsam la sogs pa nyid du zhen pa sel zhid gcod par byed pa yin no/ /de ltar lam gyis yid ches pa ni/ rtogs pa rnam bzhi'i don de nyid shes shing rig pa nyid rnal 'byor ba'i lam ste de'ang mtshan nyid theg par rgyu sngon du bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid phyis nam zhig na 'byung ba'i dus la ltos pa 112

mdzod lde'iwin bris/lta bu ma yin gyi/ da lta nyid du shes rab kyi dbang pos rang gis mngon sum du rtogs shing yid ches pa'o// zhes dang / rtogs pa bzhi ni/ 'bor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems dang ye shes kyi rang snang tsam ste don dam par rtsa ba rang byung gi ye shes su rgyu gcig pa dang / de las shar ba'i kun rdzob kyi chos rnams kyang de'i ngang tshul las ma 'das pas des yig 'bru'i tshul gyis sku dang ye shes su snang ba dang / bden pa de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med par phan tshun gcig gis gcig byin gyisabarlabs te ngo bo tha mi dad par gnas pa dang / de lta'i gnas lugs zab mo de tha snyad kyi blos spyod yul dang bral bar rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis mngon du byed pa'o/ / dag pa gsum ni/ snod 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ bcud phung po lnga bde gshegs rigs lnga/ rgyud rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar ye nasarnam par dag pa yin no ༈ /mnyam pa bzhi ni/ spros pa phyogs re chod pa rnam grangs pa dang mtha' dag chod pa rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam gnyis ka rang bzhin ma grub tsam gyis phye ba'i don dam tsam du mnyam pa dang / snang la don byed nus pa yang dag dang don byed mi nus pa log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis ka ngo bo snang tsam la btags na dben pa'i phyir kun rdzob tu mnyam pa ni thun mong mnyam pa gnyis dang / ye nas dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir/ rnam grangs pa dang rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam gnyis ka'ang lhag pa'i don dam dkor bdun ngo bo nyid du lhun gyis grub par mnyam pa dang / yang dag dang log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis ka'ang gnas tshul du ye nas dag pa'i phyir lhag pa'i kun rdzob sku dang 113

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/ye shes kyi ngo bo mnyam pa ni lhag pa'i mnyam pa gnyis bcas bzhi'o/ /bdag nyid chen po ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams snang lugs nas du mar snang yang /gnas lugs bdag nyid chen po rang byung gi ye shes nyag gcig tu nges te/mthar thug daphyod rigs kyis de ltar grub pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ rin po ches/ rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la rtogs pa bzhi'i yid ches tshul yang gtso bor 'di dang rgyu gcig pa gnyis su snang rgyu gcig par chos thams cad ces pa ni gong du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ces pa dang gcig red/ don dam 'od gsal gyi dbyings la 'jig 'das kyi mtshan ma'am spros pa gnyis char mi dmigs kun rdzob rang snang gi ngor de gnyis so so'i bya ba byed nus su shar ba'i rten 'brel du mnyam/ de gnyis dbyer med du mnyam pa rnamaba'ired pas 'dis mnyam pa dang / yig 'brus dag par rtogs pa bstan 'dra/ 'di'i stong mnyam snang mnyam gnyis ka dbu ma ltar mi 'jog par bla med lugs kho na ltar 'chad pa 'di gtsang ṭika na gsal/ mnyam lugabaltasnga ma gnyis thun mong ba dang / phyi ma gcig thun min durong 'grel gnyis na snang ba ni srid zhi gnyis bden mnyam rdzun mnyam tsam thun mong theg par yang bzhed kyang / de gnyis bden pa gnyis kar 'od gsal las phyi rol tu ma gyur par gcig pa'am dbyer med pas bzang med par mnyam pa 'di bla med kyi thun min yin zer ram snyam ste/ kun rdzob rgyu dang dbyer med de/ /lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /zhes pa lta bu red dam brtag don dam ma skyes pa a dang / kun rdzob sgyu ma o gnyis rig pa 'od gsal gcig pur rdzogs pa'i oṃ 'di bden ga nyisadabyer med lhag pa'i 114

mdzod lde'iwin bris/chos sku chen po zer rgyu de yin pa 'dra/ byin gyis rlabs par rtogs pa'i thad/ de la lar ye nas sangs rgyas par byin rlabs pa'i zhen snang yang / ye nas zhen pa med pa'i dpe dag par snang / de'ang rtogs pa snga ma gnyis kyis phung sogs chos thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su rtog pa na/ rtogs pa bzhin du phung sogs byin gyis rlabs nus pa de/ rtogs pa de dag gi stobs kyis rtogs bya'i don de dag mngon du gyur 'ong ba'o/ /de'ang rtogs pa gnyis pa'i stobs kyis ma dag pa 'am 'od tha mal ba'i snang zhen glo bur ba gnyis ka nub nas gzhi dus su gzugs tshor sogs tha mal ba'i snang bar 'ong rgyu de rnams rnam snang rin 'byung sogs kyi snang zhen du go 'pho ba skye shi bar do sku gsum du sgyur zhing rlobs pa lta bu/ de'ang ras dkar po lta bu ni phung sogs rang bzhin rnam dag dmar po nirdzoglo bur rnam dag gamartogs pa mngon gyur/ btsod ni rtogasapa gnyisared/ ras nag po sogasal tshogakha tshon po gzhan du sgyur mi gas/ dkar po kho na gang 'dod du btub/ de bzhin du gang snang thams cad rang snang res med yin pa'i gnad kyis yongs su dag pa'i lhar bsgyur nus pa sna tshogs nor bu lta bu red/ de'ang rang snang yin tshad mthar gtug na ye shes rang snang kho nar nges pa la thug lar skye 'chi bar do'ang thabasamakhas kyis zin na sku gsum du 'ong zhes pa tsam gyisa'adi'i lugs kyi lhar sgrub la dran pa rnyed dka'/ de'i kha bskor nasagadod nas sku gsum dngos su 'ong rgyu de 'khrul rgyu'i snyog nas tha mal ba'i skye shi bar dor 'char zhes pa'i steng nas 'gro dgos/ 'dir rgyu ma ngal bso'i le'u dang por ma dag gzhan dbang nub ste dgapa'i gzhan dbang 'ong tshul gsung pa'angadran par bya/ de lta bu'i rtogasapa gsum 115

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/po'ang thos bsam rkyang bas go yul tsam gyis ni gong du rdzogs pa chen pos tshul la rtogs pa bzhi'i lam gyis yid ches zhes gsungs pa'i yid ches mtshan nyid rdzogs par mi 'gyur gyis rtogs pa de gsum gyi don thos shing bsam pas 'di cig char ba red pa rtogs pa myur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi me dang spra ba phrad pa ltar snang sems rang rgyud par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs rang zhig ste rig pa yul med rang gsal du bud pa'i steng nas dag mnyam chen po'i bzhugs tshul la myong stobs kyis gting sleb pa las yid ches rnyed pa shes nas dad pa thob pa zhes pa lta bur gyur dus lta ba'i lag rjes 'jog thub pa red pas shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi lam dngos la sleb pa'o/ /'di ni mngon sum par rtogs pa ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i tshul la yid ches pa zhes pa'i rtogs par 'jog pa la rtogs pa snga ma gsum po'i khyad par 'di lta bu dgos zhes bye brag phyes nas bstan pa'o/ /rang zom pas so sor rtogs pa'i dus na yin gyi rnal 'byor gyi dus na min gsungs pa dang / g.yung gis snga ma snga ma rgyu mtshan gyis phyi ma phyi ma bstan yod snang shar ba dpyod zhes dang / yang rgyu gcig pa'i skabs ma dag pa ni ye shes kyi bzhugs tshul ltar na ri rwa lta bu dang / dag pa'ang snang tsam las med pa yin pas dbyings ngor gang yang ma grub pa la go dgos/ rgyu gcig pa'i gtan tshigs la brten nas rgyud 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byas don dam dkor bdun gyi bdag nyid dbyings mngon sum du rtogs te/gnyis chos spros mtshan gyis dben par rtogs pa dang / de yang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rtogasapa dang ma dag pa thams cad lasa'adasapa'i shin tu dag pa'i bdag 116

mdzod lde'iwin bris/nyid can du gzigs pas/ dbyings ye 'bras bu don dam dngos su rtogs pa ste/de yang rgyud 'di'i dbang du btang na zab mo'i lam dang / mthar thug chos sku thams cad 'di ngo 'phrod pa kho nas 'ong gsungs/ yig 'bru'i gtan tshig skabs/ngo bo nyid ye med na chos thams cad ji ltar snang zhe na/ ming tsam gyis bzhag pas na yi ge'i rnam 'phrul tsam mo/ /yi ge de dang gnas snang mi mthun pa'i 'khrul ba phyin ci log gis bslad pa gtan ma zhugs na des gang btags dang ci sprul gyi snang ba thams cad kyang snang tshul phyin ci log las 'das pa'i shin tu rnam dag gi snang ba 'ba' zhig tu zad pa'i snang srid thams cad gdod ma'i sdod tshul la gsungs gsang sngags kyi sgyu 'phrul kho nar gnas te/ gsung gsang sngags yi ge bya ba phyin log gi bslad pa dang bral ba'i dag pa'i yi ge dag pa rab 'byams kyi rnam 'phrul dang byed las can de la byed pas so/ /snang tshul sems rang snang gi yi ge la 'khrul ba'i ming drig mtha' med srid kyang gnas tshul ye shes rang snang gi ming tshig la gsang sngags kyi yi ge'i sprin min pa med pa'o/ /'di le'u bzhi pa dang / yig 'bru'i gtan tshigs skabs mkho min dpyod ces gsungs/gter/g.yo med skyu dgongs pa shar ba nu/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor ba de'i blo ngor chos thams cad dbyer med du sangs rgyas pa de gdod gzhon nu ma'i sogs/ dbu ma'i skabs su stong pa dang rten 'byung gnyis gcig grogs gcig song ba bzhin du/'dir dbyings ci yang ma yin pa'i gnad kyi cir yang snang ba dang / ci yang snang ba'i gnad kyis dbyings ci yang ma yin pa ni ches shin tu 'thad gsungs/ snod bcud rgyud gsum zhes pa'i thad/ rgyud sde rnam shes tshogs brgyad ni/ grub mtha' 117

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/mdzod las/ de'ang kun gzhi ni rtog med dngas ma phyed pa lung ma bstan yin la/kun gzhi'i rnam shes gsal ba ris su ma chad par gnas pa'i cha/ zhes dang /yang rtog pa dang dpyod pa chags sdang ni yid shes dang nyon yid ces dang / dngas ma phyed pa'i rtog med kun gzhi/ cung zad gsal dang tsam kun gzhi'i rnam shes/gzugs sgra sogs yul lnga rags pa dang dbang shes so so la snang ba sgo lnga'i rnamashes/ zhes gsungs pas/ ngo bo mi rtog pa'i cha nas kun gzhi rig tsam gsal tsam gyi cha nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ shesapa gcig la ldog pas phye ba yin pa 'dra gsungs/ 'di dag gnas 'gyur ye shes lngar 'gyur tshul ni/ grub mtha' mdzod kyi theg chen lam gyi 'bras bu rten sku brten pa ye shesa'achad skabasal/ oṃdag pa'i dus kyi rnam shes tshogasabargyad rten kun gzhi dang bcasapa log pasaye shes su shar ba la/ kun gzhi dag pa'i chos dbyings/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dgapas me long lta bu'i ye shes/ yid dag pa'i mnyam pa nyid/ nyon yid dag pas sosor rtogs pa/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes dag pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ sku gsumal 'jug pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi dbyings su nub poni chos kyi dbyings sgo /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni me long ye shes/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni mnyam nyid ye shes/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yi da dbyings su nub pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shesaso/ /zhes so/ 'di dag gnas 'gyur zhes pa'ang snang tshul gyi ma dag pa'i cha ye shes su shar ba la go ba las nyon mongs rang mtshan ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba mi srid de ye shes dang shin tu 'gal ba'i 118

mdzod lde'i:na stsi/snyeradang / spang byar bshad pa'ang snang tshul la dgongs pa dang / ye shes lnga bo lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i khams kyi yon tan yin pas da gsar du sgrub dgos zhigatwa rang lugs su 'dod pa'i mkhas grub su yang med pas na/ ngo bo gdod nasaye shes su 'dod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ gterayum lta dang yab lngu zhesapa/ 'byung ba bzhi ni reg bya ste yul yin pas yum la bzhag pa dang / 'byung rnang gzugs kyi phung po ni yul can yin pas yab la bzhag go /gzugs phu nga tsasayang tshor ba sogs zhes pa/ gzugs phung gcig gi yang phung po phyi ma rnams snyenon byed nus pas na ro mnyam zhes brjod la/ gzugs phung de la tshor phung khomi brjod de sdog cha tha dad du 'jog dgos so/ /༈ dbyad rgyu che yang zhes/ mdo phyogs nas gshegasasnying bstan pas 'dir bstan gyiye shes bstan par 'dod dgos so/ /'dod na lhag pa'i kun rdzob bden pa gas par yang 'dod dgos/ 'dod na thun min bden gnyis 'jog par dka' 'apaskyon med pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud bla'i bshad bya rtsa bar bstan pa'i mdo bzhi ni gshegs snying bstan pa'i mdo/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i mdo/dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo/ byams pa seng ge'i zhus pa'i mdo rnams dmigs bsal du byas nas/ mdo phyogs phyir btang la stos te thun min du 'jog pa lo dzee gyis bzhed pa'o/ /grub mtha'i thad/ mi pham rin po'i ches/ don gyi ye shes sgro ba lta bu mngon du mthong ba'i tshe na don gyi ye shes dngos mthong ba yin yo /tshesagacig zla ba zla ba dngos yin kyang da dung bco lnga'i bar rgya cher mthong ba yod pabazhin/ sgom pa'i lam du don gyi ye shes mthong ba cher 'phel te/ mthar 119

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/thugs bco lnga'i zla ba mthong ba ltar mthong ba yongs su rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'grub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ /rin po ches/ tshad pheb dus ngo bo'i steng du btsan sa zen pa yin par gsungs/ gteradagā rdzogs smin gsum zhes pa/mar skye 'chi bar do gsum dag yar 'bras bu sku gsum rdzogs pa ste/ dgag sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jog pa dang smin pa ni bskyed rim de nyid rdzogs rim smin byed kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'am/ de yang bskyed rim gyi stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang / snying rje rgyu ma nas bzung ste spros bcas kyi bar 'bras bu chos gzugs gnyis kyi brgyud rgyu byed pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi 'od gsal dang stong gzugs gnyis kyi 'bras bu chosagazugs gnyis kyi dngos rgyu byed pa'o/ /dngo sa sgyu bsgyur ba'i lam zhes pa/ rdzogs rim yin la/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi rnam grol lam la 'phos nas 'bras bu la nying mtshams sbyor ba'o/ /rdzog sa pa'i bskyed pa zhes pa/ stong chen la gom pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur te/ rjes su snying rje rgyu ma sgom pa lta bu/ bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa zhes/ bskyed rim gyi snying rje sgyu ma'i rnam 'byor bsgom pa'i rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la go 'phos nas ma bcos pa'i snying rje sgyu mar song ba lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gter/bzhag thabs gnyi sa thad/ bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas rig pa ma bcos pa'i ngang du so mar 'jog pa rig pa spyi blug dang / sngar thos bsam gyi lta ba dran par byas nas de'i ngang du 'jog par mthong ba'i rjesal 'jog pa ste/ 'jog thabs gnyisagang rung gi don dam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa nyin mo'i rnal 'byor dang / mtshan mo gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i man ngag 120

mdzod lde'i:na bris/gnyisasbrel ba'o/ /yang dang po tshogs brgyad las 'das pa'i rig stong zung 'jug gi ngang du 'jog pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni sngar gyi ngang 3snar na slar yang yang dag gnyug ma'i dran pas rgyun bskyang ba'o/ /rin po che'i/ dgongs rgyan dang sdom ṭīka sogs mang por stong chen gyi skabs su/ sad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal dang / mtshan mo gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal gnyis sbrel te nyams su len par gsungs shing /snying rje sgyu ma'i thad du sad rmi gnyis kyi snang ba mthong bar bshad pa'ang snang ba de dag stong gzugs su lam khyer byed pa'am/ tha mal pa la snang ba de gnyis 'char ba'i dod du stong gzugs mthong zhes par mngon pas/ des ni rnal 'byor dang po gnyis gnyid rmi lam gnyis kyi skabs su skyong tshul bstan no/ /rmi lam du 'ong rgyu rnams stong gzugs ye shes kyi snang bar 'char zhes bstan pa dang / de ltar shar ba'i stong gzugs de rim gyi phyag rgya gcig spros su'ang 'char bar gong bzhin bshad pas/ phyag rgya gcig spros rmi lam du sbyang tshul thon no/ /gzhi la srid pa bar do ma grub gong chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char ba ltar rmi lam ma mthong ba'i sngon du lhun grub kyi gzhi snang mthong bar man ngag snying thig tu gsungs pa dang / 'di'i steng sgo rnal 'byor ba'i gnyid thug gi rgya spros gnyis mthun dgos te/ 'di'i stong gzugs dang chos nyid bar do'i snang ba gnad gcig bar dgongs rgyan dang shing rta chen mor bshad pas so/ /zhes dang / yang lam rim lung skabs/ gang dag dngos kun rang rig phyir/ /'chi ba don dam bden pa ste/ /sogs kyis bskyed rim pas mos ngor dang / rdzogs rim pas dngos su 'chi bachos skur sbyong byed stong chen/ bar dor longs skur sbyong byed snying rje sgyu ma sogs 121

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/sgom par bstan pas/ stong chen dang 'chi ba bsre ba sogs kyi 'thon no/ /'on kyang 'di'i sad pa dang skye ba sbyong byed ni/ rmi lam dang bar do sbyong byed du'ang mi'agal ba'i/ snying thig tu/ 'chi ba dang / chosanyid bar de'i lam khyer gnyisapo kho nas bar do dang skye ba kun spyong bar bzhed pa dang mthun no/ /bar chad med pa li ting nge 'dzin zhes pa/ skye ba dang lam gzhan gyi bar ma chod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/lo tshod bstun par 'dod ces par/ rin po ches gsungs rgyun las lha rje kha rags pa sogs kyis bzhed pa ni/ zag bcas zag med kyi lam dgu po 'di dag la rgyu'i theg pa'i sa lam dang gung sbyor te/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin tshogasalam chung ngu dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang / kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin tshogasalam 'bring po yang dag sbong bzhi dang / phyag rgya gcig pa la tshogs lam chen bo rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi dang / spros bcas sbyor lam chung ngu drod rtse gnyis dang /tshogs sgrub sbyor lam chen po'i bzod pa chos mchog gnyis dang / rnam smin mthong lam dang po/ tshe dbang sa dang po'i bden pa mthong ba dang / phyag chen sa gnyisapa nas dgu pa'i bar dang / lhun grub rig 'dzin sa bcu chos kyi sgrin dang lo tshod mnyam pa yin gsungs/ sa dang po thob pa'i tshe nyon sgrib kun btags lhan skyes gnyis kyi khyad par ma phye bar mtha' dag spong ba'o/ /zhesagasungs/ ༈ gter/tshe dbang rig 'dzin skabs/ rtogs tshogasaru trar bshad pa'i khams drug ldan gyi rdo rje'i lus kyi dngas ma stobs su gyur cing / snyigs ma de las gyur pa'i lus khamasaskye gnasakyi zag pa zad pa'i dbang gis/ phar phyin dusasathob dusathamasacad mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa dang mthun pa/ zhes pa ltar/ 'dir yang las rlung 122

mdzod lde'i:na bris/ ṣka'akhrul rgyus dkrug pa'i sems mi gsal ba rnams mnyam rjes kun tu shes cher dngasashing gzi byin chos kyi dbyings ltar tshad gzung dang bral ba'i 'od gsal sgyu salta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis snang sems thams cad non zhing kha dog bsgyur ba ni/shasdang 'dus las/ sgyu lus thob nas lus sems phra rags kyi 'brel rags pa cad nas mi rgyu ba dang dod mtshung pa'am/ yang na zung 'jug thob nas 'brel phra mo chad pa'i dod do/ /'di rgya mtsho las/ 'byung bzhi dngas ma la brten pas/ /rig pa'i bde chen bar chad med/ /rnam rtog 'gyu ba'i rlung dngas bas/ /bde chen nam mkha'i mtha' ltar gnas/ zhes le'u bcu bzhi par bshad pa dang phyogs 'dra'o/ /'dir g.yung gi gsungs nas/ bden pa'i phyogs gcig mthong ba rnam smin/bden stong rdzogs par mthong ba tshe dbang / mthong thin gom byed phyag chen gsungs pa dang / spyod bsdus las/ sems dben pa la bden pa mthong ba 'di/zhes dpe'i 'od gsal spros pa phyogs re kheng pa'i cha nas don dam 'od gsal ges btags pa ltar 'dug pa'ang ma 'bor zhes gsungs/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ rgya mig ni thel tshe'i ngo'i ri mo dang / rgya pa ni la cha sogs rgya 'debs pa de zhi no/ /༈ mi pham rin po che'i shan 'byed las/ ngo bo nyid sku de ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dag pa gnyis ldan yin pas de'i mkhyen cha ye shes chos sku dang /gzugs sku rnams gnyis nyi ma dang 'od zer bzhin du 'du 'bral med pa yin pas gzugs sku'i dbang du byas na longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sogasakha sbyor bdun gyi bdag nyid yod par khas len dgos te/123

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/kha spyor bdun ni ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ snying rje yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gogs pa med/ /cesagasungs/ 'og min du sa bcu pa'i byang sems la chos kyi longs spyod rdzogs par mdzad pa dang /1 ye shes kyi rang bzhin can gyi mtshan dpe'i sku rang gi btsun mo dang kha sbyor du bzhugs pa dang /2 zag med kyi bdī ba chen pos rgyud yongs su gang ba dang /3 rang bzhin gyi ngo bo med pa dang /4 snying rjes yongs sgyu gang bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang /5 de'i mdzad pa nam mkha' ji srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa dang /6 'gogs pa med pa mi gnas kyi myang 'das so/7 /de ltar yang btsun mo'i bde ba dang ldan pa sogs/ rgyud rang mtshan pa'i chags spyod smad pa'i tshul can ma yin te/ sku rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i bye brag 'khor 'das kyi chos kun la bdag po chen po'i tshul du mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i zag med sdi bde ba chen po la/ mnga' dbang 'byor ba yin pas/ 'brasachos nyer lnga lhun gyisagrub pa yin no/ /spyan sogs skye mched drug ldan gyi sku mtshan dpe bzhin lag tu snang yang mig sogs la bdag gir 'dzin pa sogs yod mi dgos la/ yum dang gdan khri gzhal yas sogs 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad de bzhin te/ spros bral don gsal chen po'i rgyud las/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gdan khri la sogs pa/ /snang yang yang dag don du grub pa med/ /chos sku'i yon tan tsam du snang ba yin/ /rtsal gdangs ma 'gags cha tsam shar ba yin/ /mkhyen pa'i shes rab tsam las gsal ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ sku la che chung gi tshad du snang yang gar yang khyab pa'i chu zla lta bu la rdul phran kyi tshad bsags pa med pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /124

mdzod lde'i:na bris/sangasargyas kyi sku la res su phye ba'i rgyud rang mtshan med kyang dag pa'i gdul byar snang ba'i longs sku de yang sangs rgyas yin pa dang / kha sbyor bdun ldan du khas len pa la skyon gang yang med de/ rgyud sde chen po rnams kyis dgongs pa rnam dag yin no/ /der ma zad sprul pa'i sku la'ang / kun mkhyen chen po'i tshig don mdzod dugadul bya'i ngor snang ba'i sprul pa'i sku de yang bem stong gzugs brtan lta bu ma jin par ye shes gnyis kyi 'gro ba'i don lhun grub tu mdzad pa ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ ye shes yod pa dang sangs rgyas yin par khas len dgos kyi/desangasargyasamin pa dang ye shesamed par nam yang skur pa 'debasami drang ngo / /mdor nathal 'gyur las/ tha dad rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /de phyir sku lnga'i ye shes te//sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /don la de bzhin gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ / ༈dad brtson gyi spyod pa bdun gyi dang po ni/ mi pham rin po ches bka' brgyad kyi rnam bshad dngos grub snying po las/ gsang sngags kyi bslab pa'i mtha' bcu'am drug tu 'du ste/ rgyud thos pas grol/ sgo kun nas sdud/ mdo gcig tu bsdus/mkhas pa phul du phyin par bslab bzhi'i sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ste/ thog mar rgyud lung man ngag gi don zab mo ma thos na blang dor gyi dmigs mi 'byed pas rgyud thos pas grol ba rta pho sgrog bkrol ba lta bu gzhir bzhag de yang thos pa nyung ngus shes rab rgya chen po grol bar mi nus pas thos pa'i sgo mang po btsal te sgo kun nas sdud pa bung ba tshang tshol ba lta bus mang du thos par bya/ mang du thos kyang lag len gnad du ma khel na rang rgyud mi grol ba'i mthar thug pa'i man ngag gi gnad zab mo nyams 'og tu tshud par byas nas mdo gcig tu sdud pa tshong pa khe 125

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/tshol ba lta bu'i don gnad du phog par bya/ de ltar byas nas thos pas rgyud kyi don shes/ lung gis rgyud don nyams su blang / man ngag gis yid ches nas the tshom med pa'i gdeng dang ldan par bslab pa'i sgo nas mkhas pa phul du phyin pa ri mthon po'i rtser phyin pa lta bu zhig bya ste/ de bzhi ni gsang sngags la bslab pa'i tshul lo/ /de bzhi'i steng du bslab bya'i yul skyes cha nas bslab pa'i mtha' drug tu gsungs pa bsnan nas bslab pa'i mtha' bcur bzhed do/ /de la bslab pa'i mtha' drug gang zhe na/ rim pa dbang gis bsgrod/ gzhi dam tshig gis bzung /thag lta bas bcad/ nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blang / la spyod pas dor/ don man ngag gis sgrub pa drug go /de la rim pa dbang gis bsgrod pa ni gsang sngagasakyi dbang thob pa dang / gsang ba'i dbang thob nas nyon mongs pas mi brdzi ba'i las can du gyur pa rgyal bus rgyal sa zin pa lta bu'o/ /gzhi dam tshig gisabazupa ba ni bla ma mnyes par byas la ji skad gsungs pa'i dam tshig las mi 'da' ba zhing sa gshin po lta bu dngos grub kyi lo tog skye rung ba'i las can no/ /thag lta bas bcad pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la sems ye nas sangs rgyasapa rang byung gi ye shes su rtogs nas bya rtsol re dogs dang bral te bag yangs su rgyu ba khyung nam mkha' la lding ba lta bu'o/ /nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyi blang ba ni shes rab kyis dmigs pa'i don la ting nge 'dzin gyis g.yeng ba med par rtse gcig tu byas pa nor bu rin po che len pa lta bu'o/ /la spyod pas dor ba ni mnyam bzhag tu bya ba'i lasathams cad spangs na sgom pa'i lasal 'jug pa dang / rjes thob tu blang dor med pa mnyamopa nyid kyi lta ba zab mo dang 126

mdzod lde'iwin bris/mthun par 'jigs med du rgyu zhing phrin las sna tshogs la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'jug pa glang po che chur 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /don man ngag gis sgrub pa ni gang ched dusgrub pa'i don la gnad du 'byor ba'i man ngag gis the tshom med pa'i gdeng dang rdon par sgrub pa nyams su lon nas ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i dus na bdud bzhi chom nas sku gsum thob pa rin chen nyos pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar mtha' drug la bslab cing sher ting gi yo byad gnyis la longs spyod pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug mu po'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /la dor ba ni brda rnying ste/ bog 'don la go dgos/rga'adra'i brda snga 'gyur las gzhan las mi 'byung gsungs/༈ rig 'dzin bzhi'i spyod pa zhal lung na gsal lo/227 /'grel chung la sa dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bshad pa/ zhes pa ni/ 'grel chung las/ dkyil 'khor rnams pa bcu gnyis te/ /de bzhin nyid dang rang bzhin dang / /thugs rje 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang gzugs brnyan dang / /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dang / /byang chub sems dang lhag byang sems/rtags dang lhun grub dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes so/ /don dam pa'i gzugs brnyan sogs nas rnam par shar ba'o/ /zhes pa 'dir/ lha rje mda' tig don dam pa'i gzugs brnyan kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'byung ba la bzhed/ lha rje glan ston/rnam rtog phra rags kyis lha yab yum du mtshon pa de'o gsungs/ nyang ṭika pa ni/snga ma'i bzhed pa de gnyis char yang / /'og min na bzhugs pa dang / 'di ltar bsgom pa'i gsal ba gnyis 'dra ba'i phyir gzugs brtan no gsungs/ de gsusalung ni mthun par/ rgyas pa las/ gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor yang dag ni/ /127

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/chen po rig pa thabs su rtogs/ /so so'i mtshan nyid shes rab rtogs/ /gnyis gnyis 'brel ba thabs chen yin/ /zhes so/ /sa brtags/ sa bslang rbe1gas zhanya lung na gsal/239 gram tshal sgyu phyag sogs kyang der gsal 'osto/ / ༈gter/ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum thad/ rdzogs chen dang bstun nas bskyed rim ting 'dzin rnam gsum sgom dus/ de ting ka dag gzhi'i skabs/ kun snang rang bzhin lhun grub gzhi snang gi ye shes/ lha ting ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug thugs rje'i rig pa shes rab kyi cha thams cad thod rgal ba'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud du 'ong rgyu de red/dkyil 'khor lha bskyed shes rab skur smin pa'i zhing sku pho brang sogs la sbyor snyams/ shes rab skur smin pa 'di la sprul sku longs sku gnyis ka yod pas/ sgyu 'phrul ltar lhar bskyed kyi lha so drug chos sku longs sku/ drug sprul skur byas nas sgom pa lta bur yang sbyar btub gsungs/ bzhugs tshul lha gnas sogs zhal lung na gsal lo/250 /dbang skabs/ spyir dbang la/ smin par byed pa rgyu'i dbang / grol bar byed pa lam gyi dbang / grol ba 'bras bu'i dbang dang gsum gyi tha snyad la gsar rnying gnyis 'dra yang / ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ste/ gzhan dag grol byed kyi lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang / grol ba 'bras dbang mi slob lam la byed rang lugs grol byed lam dbang ni lam dbang thams cad thod rgal du len pa ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs dang / sgrub thabs 'ga' la dbang bzhi len tshul yod pa lta bu dang / bdag 'jug blang ba lta bu la byed/ 'bras dbang ni 'bras bu mi slob zung 'jug la de ma thag 'tshams sbyar ba'i dbang la mdzad/rin po ches/ 'dir sngags sdom skye dus ni dam tshig sbyin pa'i mjug tu yin la/128

mdzod lde'i:na bris/byang sdom ni zhal lung du sngon rab ba'i gsungs sgros drangs pa dkyil chog gi sngar sgog nas byed pa lta bur snang la/ lus dbul dgos pa gsum phyir byed pa'i skabs su thob rgyur byas kyang rung ngam ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod bzhin no//dbang gi grangs bzhir rgyud phyi ma las te/ der dbang dang po la bum dbang zhes ma bshad cing / nyan dbang sogs la mtha' brten chu dbang mi 'dug pa'i slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya ste gtso bo'i sgo nas btags pa'o/ /dbang de dkyil 'khor pa la thob par bya dgos te/ gzhan du dkyil 'khor bzhengs sgrub kyang / der dbang bskur bar 'dod nas min dgos la/ dal gyi lha'i dgongs gtad mdzad pa'i tshig zin yang cher ma thon yang 'jug pa'i 'og dbang dngos gzhi'i mtshams sbyor na dkyil 'khor pa la mchod bstod byas nas bdag gi slob ma 'di dag la dbang bskur byed pa la byin gyis rlobs pa'i grogs mdzod ces gsol ba 'debs par bshad pa des thon snyams ste/ de dgongs pa gtod ched yin pas so/ /phan dbang la bcur phye ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal bor ma bshad kyang / le'u bcu par rgyal po sbyin pa'i ting 'dzin zhes gsungs ltar phan dbang gis chos kyi rgyal po'i chas su bcug nas rigs lnga'i rgyal thabs la dbang ba'i rten 'brel bzhi bsgrigs nas/ nus dbang dang zab dbang gis rim gyis chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang ba'i nus pa dngos su bskyed pa yin la/ de'i tshe rgyal po rnams la rgyal po'i che rtags gtso bo dbu rgyan cod phan/ rgol bas mi tshugs pas go cha/bza' btung sogs 'dod yon/ srid mtho ba'i rtags gdugs sogs yod pa dang bstun nas bzhag pa/ dusa'akhor du byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes129

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/pa bzhin no snyam ste dpyad/ dbu rgyan rin po che'i khang bu rin chen rigs kyi lha gnas thad pa nas bza' btung lus brtas byed yin pas sku'i rigs rnam snang gi rab gnas 'thad pa'i bar du yang dpyod tshul dgos 'dra yang / mi gsal bas blo bzor 'gro 'am snyams/ phan dbang nyan sgom gyi dbang rdo rje slob ma'i dbang du don gyis 'gro yang tha snyad mi byed/ 'chad phrin gyis ngag gi thig le la rgyud 'chad pa'i byin rlabs skye mched 'od dpag med kyi dbang bskur nas gnang ba ston pa dang / lus kyi thig le la byin gyis brlabs nas las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i mthu bskyed pa'i sgo nas slob dpon du 'os pa'i gzhi bsgrub te gdod slob dpon gyi dbang dngos ster ba yin pas de gsum slob dpon dbang gi phyogs su 'gro bar bshad/ 'di'i dbang bzhi pa'i thal rgyud kyi tshig na/ bde chen las bsgrub pa'i mtshan dpe ngo sprod yod pa'i/ chos gzugs kyi sku zung 'jug la ngo 'phrod rgyu gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs/ chas bcu zhes pa ni/ rgyan chas rtags la bcu yin te/ dbu rgyan 1bum pa 2snying po lnga3/ /cod pan 4go cha 5phreng ba 6rgyan7/ /thod 'phreng 8rtag gsum 9 me dpung ngo 10/ /nus pa'i dbang ni lngar nges te/ /nyan bsgom 'chad las rab 'byams dbang / /sgrub pa'i dbang la bco lnga ste/ /bdud rtsi 1lnga dang sha lnga dang 2/ /rakta 3rgyal mtshan 4gdugs 5kha ṭwāṃ6/ /phur pa 7rdor dril /rnge'u chung 9/ /yungs dkar 10gzung ma 11 phreng ba dang 12/ /tshe dang 13bza' btung 14ming dbang ngo 15/ /zab dbang gsum ste gsang ba dang / khes rab ye shes bde chen po/ /zhes so/ /byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ byis pa skyebashal ma rnamabashakyis/ /chu yi 'khrud pa'i dbang bskur byed/ /130

mdzod lde'iwin bris/de yi gtsug phud rab 'jog pa/ /cod pan du ni yongs su brtags/ /de yi rna ba 'bug pa sogs/ /dar dpyang dbang bskur byed par bshad/ /byis pa smra dang dgod pa ni/ /dril bu rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro/ /lnga pa longs spyod brtul zhugs yin/ /ming ni ming gis dbang bskur yin/ klog pa la sogs rjes gnang ba/ /bu dag gis ni rab tu ster/ /de ltar rnam pa bdun gyis ni/ /dbang bskur bdun du rab tu grags/ /zhes rbedu/ /gter/'og sgo'i rnal 'byor skabs/ yas babs dga' ba bcu drug theg chen thun mong ba'i sa lam dang / phar phyin bcur sbyar zhing mas bstan gyi bcu drug gsang sngags nang gi sa lam dang sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje las rim las/ pha rol phyin dang sa mtshan nyid/ /mtshungs phyir rdzogs par bshad pa yin/ /zhes mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'am chos mtshungs kyi sgo nas yin par bshad de/ phar phyin tu thun mong ba'i phar phyin bcu'i rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba'i gnas skabs las sa bcu sogs su 'jog pa bzhin tu/ 'dir sa lam thams cad bde chen gyi rtogs pa de nyid gong du 'phel ba'i rim pa'i steng nas 'jog par mtshon pa dang / dga' ba bcu drug po bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par las phye ba bzhin du/ sngags bla med kyi sa lam rnams kyang bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor na 'phar ba'i gnas skabs kyi dbye ba dang / da lta bde ba na 'phar ba'i gnas skabs la dga' ba bcu drug tu phye ba 'di ltar/ ma 'ongs pa bde chen 'di'i rgyun 'phel ba'i gnas skabs rnams rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcur 'ong zhes bshad na mun sel gyi dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod thad du 'grigs mchan/ phyag rgya dang snyom par 'jug thengs gcig gis 131

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/dga' ba bcu drug po rdzogs nus pa bzhin du/ bde chen gyi lam la brten na sa dang lam thams cad ches myur ba kho nar rdzogs par 'gyur zhes mchog gi bde ba'i rnal 'byor skad cig ma tsam yang lam bsgrod pa'i nus pa phul du byung bar shes ched/ gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba thun gcig la sa bcu lam lnga tshangs bar bsgrod pa lta bur bstan pa ste/ bde stong gi lam gyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /mdor bsdu na/dwangs snyigs kyi snang ba thams cad mi shig pa gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul yin yang /da lta snyigs ma'i bskyed pa'i sems dang snang cha'i steng nas tha mal ba'i zhen pa rtsal zhugs mched de 'khrul ba yin cing / de sbyong ba la/ dang por bskyed rim gyis sems de ka'i steng nas snang zhen de sdud pa'i sgo btod nas slar rdzogs rim gyis dwangs ma'i sems mthar thug pa gsal zhing rjen par phyungs te/ de'i rang snang gi steng nas dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyangs te sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa yin no/ /sems can gyi shes pa'i cha thams cad snyigs pa'i snang ba 'phrog pa'i skabs ni mi srid de/ gnyug sems snang ba de dang mi 'grogs pas so/ /dwangs ma'i snang bas ni shes pas cha ma lus pa bsgyur du yod de/ sems gzhan thams cad dwangs ma'i snang ba'i rnam pa can gyi gnyug sems kho na la bsdus pa'i skabs yod pa'i phyir te/ rang byung kun ngam lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs/ de ma theg rkyen dkyil 'khor du 'jugu pa la sogs/ 'jug tshul bco brgyad du bsdus nas zhal lung na yod/ /gter/dam tshig thad/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga'i rtsa lhung ston pa min te/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig bzhin no/ /yan lag la/ nang dug lnga'i rnam rtog ci shar yang de la ma dag pa'i snang zhen gyis sbongs bsgyur gzhan mi byed par nyon 132

mdzod lde'iwin bris/mongs pa de rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i gnas lugs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa'i gnad kyis/ mi bskyod pa sogs rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi ngo bo gdod nas dag tshul sngags bla med spyi'i gang shar bde stong du lta lugs bzhin du bltas nas/ gang shar gyi nyon mongs thams cad bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs kho nar 'khyer ba dang / phyi 'jig rten na shin tu dme bar grags pa'i rdzas lnga yang dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bdud rtsir byas nas bde chen gyi bcud len du brten pa ste lnga tshan gnyis so/ /yang dag dug lnga ni log pa'i dug lnga po 'khor 'das so sor mi rtogs pa'i gti mug sogs su blta ched bzhag gam dpyad/ rgyud 'dir chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par mthong zhing goms pa'i rnal 'byor lam gyi srog rgyu yang yang rtsal bton gyis ston la/ de'i tshe phyi rol gyi rdzas ma dag pa phyi sa sogs dang / nang rnam rtog ma dag pa dug lnga lta bu'ang dag pa rab 'byams kyi rnal 'byor gcig bu'i grogs su 'khyer ba 'di nyid kyi dgos gyi dam tshig tu brtan pas kyang lam kyi sgog de nyid dang rnam pa kun tu 'bral mi rung zhes bstan par nges pa rnyed do ces gsungs/ spyir dam tshig gyi rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang / zhes pa ni/ rgyud gzhung :'i lugs kyi dam tshig sogs zhal lung na gsal lo/ /dam tshig bco lnga la dbye tshul zhal lung sogs na gsal lo/ /rnal 'byor spyi khrus sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa ni glang chen rab 'bog gi rgyud las rtog pa gcig khol du phyung ba kalnga dum bu'i rgyud dri med bshags rgyud las gsungs pa ltar yo ga gsum gyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis nyams chags dang rtog sgrib thams 133

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/cad sbyong bar byed pa'i spyi khrus med du byung ba na raka dong sprugs kyi man ngag la brten nas sgyi yo byad tshogs kyi bskang bshags/ nang phung po rten gyi bskang bshags/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi bskang bshags nya stong tshes brgyad la byas pa'i de tshun chad kyi nyams chags rtog sgrib thams cad dag par gsungs la/de ltar ma nus na'ang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan nas brjod pa yi dam du bgyis pas kyang nyams chags thams cad dag par gsungs te/ gang zhig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ /nyams chags kun kyang byang 'gyur te/ /mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang 'byung / /na raka gnas kyang dong sprug te/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//gzhan yang bshags pa'i rgyu chen bzhi ste/ yang dag don gyi gcug sbyang phyir rtogs pa lta ba'i sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung lta ba'i klong bshags/ lha mi'i gcug sbyang phyir bsgom pa bskyed rdzogs kyi sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung ye shes sku mchog /rtsa ba dang yan lag gi gcug sbyang phyir bsrung bya dam tshig gi sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung dam tshigs nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro'i gcug sbyang phyir gdung ba smre sngags kyi sgo nas bshags pa'i gzhung ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bshags pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang dus 'khor dang snying po brgyan sogs las gsungs pa rnams sdom ṭīka las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang phyi yo byad tshogs kyis bskang ba/ mar me dang tshogs gtor sman raka brgya rtsa brgyad bcas gdung ba'i sems kyis bshag nang phung po rten gyi bskang ba/ dkar cha sman/ dmar cha rakta/rtsa kham gtor ma/ rlung sems kyi cha mar me/ gsang ba byang chub semasakyi bskang ba/134

mdzod lde'iwin bris/rang byung rig pa'i snashisabadechen sman/ngo bo stong pa rakta/zung du wīg pa gtor ma/rang ba—na gsal ba spyo me sogasakyi sgo nas nya stong dzee brgyad sogs laltags/dernyinusanaphyagag bkol byang tsam rgyun du ya dam du bya'o//gnas rdzas thabs sogs zhal lung na gsal lo spyo gsungs/'on te grol lam gyisadangosagrub sgrub tso lta bu dang bstun na stopa'i thad/rin po che ṣka kyi gsungs wo/man ngag 'di'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim thabs grol gyisakhyad par/mtshon byed kyisathabs kyis rdzogasarim pa'i zhu bde myong ba oṃ go thabs lam dang /mardzo bya don rig stong gdod ma'i gnas lugs dngos la reg pa na grol lam du bzhed ces khingasapas/galhu ra mtshwa bya don gyiganasalugasartogasapa'i lam gyisamathar rang gi yin lugs dngos gsal bar sad pa 'am lam mngon du gyur pa mthar thug pa na yosa.apa spyobarjod pa yin pas/to dgosadang rang oṃ kyi brjod bya don gyigatso 45 ji ///kho ///sgo 45 ribogakhopa ga hphulan spyongesapa lhag par 'drong ba tsā yod zer wo dpyad/simardzo ṣka la ngal ba'i sabon 'ga'//tsod lasargyu wīn sdong po ྾ gyorta//zab lam mdor bsdusastsosaster tī ltad kyi/yal 'dab phyogasadusakhyab par sre gyur cig/phyi snod ga4 wo rgyud sde'i mdzod du gyur//naḍi lto 'gro kun rig won byi bur ko//brtan g.yo mtha' dag sgyu snyul drwa ba ya//dkyil wor snyor lo ga tu byang chub shog/ces gsungs so//lhamada' dbon po dma bsam hrūb spyasamadza/

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/༄7/ /spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig slob bshad skabs kyi zhal rgyun zin bris 'jigs med bla ma'i zhal lung bzhugs so//༄7/ /phyi ltar 'dula'adzin nye spu'akhor ltar btsun/ /nang ltar yum don mkhasapa'i pha rol phyin/ /gsang ba nges gsang rdor rje'i rnal 'byor mchog /bka' drin mtshungs med rig 'dzin bzang por 'dud/ /bka' drin can gyi bla ma dran pa na/ /bsod nam phung po dpag med 'byung ba'i phyir/ /bla ma mi brjed dran pa'i brjed bskul du//zhal rgyun rgyu skar phreng ba 'di na 'god/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod par brjod pa dang / khengs pa bskyung zhing rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis/ dang po la rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi la mchod par brjod pa/ thun min don rgyud kyi bla ma la mchod par brjod pa/ brgyud pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba'o /7/ bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar ni/ 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun snga dar rgyal po khri srong gi sku dus su sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas jo bo ma byon gyi bar dang / jo bo byon nas bzung phyi dar yen/ /sngags gsar ma dang rnying ma ni/ gtso bo rgyal po khri srong dang / sras mu khri btsad po dang mnga' bdag khri ral gyi sku dus su bsgyur ba'i sngags bla med rnams ni snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / de'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la rnying ma pa zhes bya/ lo chen rin bzang nas rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po'i bar gyis bsgyur 136

zin bris 'jigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /ba'i sngags bla med rnams la sngags gsar ma zhes bya/ rnying ma la mdo sgyu sems gsum dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ni snga 'gyur bka' ma'i skor dang / slob dpon chen pos 'khor rje 'bangs sogs kyis bsgoms stobs kyis mngon du gyur pa'i shin tu phra ba gnyug ma'i 'od gsal la/ dbang lung man ngag tshig dang yi ge thams cad gtad rgya mdzad pa ste/ de la bstim par mdzad pa phyis rbesnag ser sogs kyi rkyen dang / sngon gyi smon lam las dbang lung man ngag tshig don mtha' dag sad pa'i tshul ni dgongs gter dang sa gter kun la 'dra'o/ /des na sa gter yang dgongs gter dang rnam pa 'dra ba ltar snang / bka' gter gyi gsung rab mtha' dag gi brjod bya mthar thug bden gnyis kyi rdzogs rim gyi gnad gsang ma lus pa rgyud 'dir 'dus pas na de dag gi nang mdzod/ rgyud ma hā yo ga ste rnal 'byor chen po/ lung a nu yo ga ste rjes su rnal 'byor/ man ngag a ti yo galte shin tu rnal 'byor gsum gyi lugs ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo dang / spyi mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa lta bu yin la/ der ni theg pa rim pa dgu'i rnam bzhag ston pas na lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel ltar gyur pas na lung dang mdo zhes so/ /rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa la ma ltos par rang gnas kyi ye shes gsal bar mtshon tshul ston pas na man ngag rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i lam gnad zin na/rgyud lung man ngag de dag gi lam gnad kyang bde blag tu zin la/rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i lam gnad ma zin na rgyud lung man ngag de dag gi rang thad kyi lam gnad zin dka' bas na de dag gi srog shing / de yang bden gnyis kyi rdzogs rim rgyas par ston pa'i gnad kyis yin/ ༈ chos kyi snang ba rlabs chen po ni/137

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/gtso bor rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud yin te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis rang nyid kyis brnyes pa'i go 'phang la gdul bya rnams 'god par bzhed la/ de'ang rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud don la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba sogs kyang 'di'i smin byed du 'gyur ba ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i skabs su rgyal ba'i yum gyi dgongs don la gsung rab gzhan gzhol bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ / / btags pa'i lus dang rnam smin gyi lus dang tshul bstan gyi lus gsum don gcig /ye shes kyi lus dang rang bzhin gyi lus dang gnyug ma'i lus rnams don gcig rnam smin gyi lus zhes pa ni gdul bya'i snang tshod ltar yin gyi don la ye shes kyi lus so/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskul tshul ni/ rab mtha'i bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag tshe/ 'di 'dra'i lam gyis sangs rgyas mi thob/ 'og min du gshegs nas rdo rje theg par 'jug par bskul pa yin/ 'dis phar phyin theg pa'i lam la sngags kyi snon pa 'debs tshul bstan/༈ mngon byang lnga ni nang gi mngon byang lnga ste/ dang por chos kyi dbyings la mngon par byang chub/ de nas me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya grub ste phar phyin theg pa'i skabs bzhin no/ / ༈ dper na dus 'khor gyi skabs/ dpal ldan 'bras spung du dus 'khor gyi rgyud gsungs pa na rgyud mtha' dag bstan par gsungs pa dang /nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du in dra bho dhi la gsang 'dus gsungs pa na/ 'jig rten khams na srid tshad kyi rgyud gnas gzhan du yang gsungs par bshad pa ltar 'dir yang 'di nyid la sogs pa'i rgyud sde mtha' yas pa ston zhes pa'o/ /༈138

zin bris 'jigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /lha da tshul gnyis mi 'gal tshul ni/ snga ma ltar khas blang na phyi ma mi khegs/ phyi ma ra khas blang na snga ma khegs mi dgos pa'i don no/ / ༈dgongs brgyud ces shā dgongs pa ni/ rnying ma'i chos skad de/ de ni ye shes dang ting nge 'dzin la bya/de la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gang las na kun tu bzang po las so/ gang la na/rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i 'bor dang / rig pa khyad par can gyi 'khor la'o/skyobaltar na dgongs pa gcig pa ste/ thugs dgongs pa gcig gis 'brel ba'am tsheshes gcig gis bsdus pa'o/ ༈ /ston pa rigs drug pa zhes pa'i don ni/thigs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i don yin/ rigs mtha' dag bsdom pa'i ngo bor phangs rgyas na/ rigs lnga gzhan gyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa la dogs pa med/ kun tu bzang po zhes pa'i don spyod yul yongs su dag pa ste/ phung khams thams cad ro mnyam rdo rje'i lhar dag pa ste/ ma dag pa'i cha mtha' dag sbyangs nas spyod yul thams cad ye shes rang snang nyag gcig tu gyur pa la nyes pa dang rgud pa'i cha ma dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /ston pas rgyud don mthar phyin par brnyes tshul yang / thun chong gi lam sngon du btang ste/ gsang sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang thob pa dang / de'i lam mthar phyin te/ slob pa'i mtha'i 'od gsal gyi rags pa'i phung khams kyi cha rnams 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs pa na/ mes bud shing bsregs pa na du ba 'byung ba bzhin/ chos sku brnyes pa dang longs sku grub ste/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i zer ltar rgyal ba rigs lnga dang yum lnga sems dpa' sems ma spro ba la go rim med ces gsungs so/ /zab dbang bskur tshe phyi rol gyi rdzas dang sngags dang phyag rgya'i 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par dbang bskur ba dang / dbang re re bzhin du dbang gi 139

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/lam rgyud la skyes pa'o/ /mdor na 'bad rtsol phra ba yang med pa'i don no/ /'chad pa po dag pa'i sems dpa' zhes pa ni/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug kho na ste/ rgyal sras rigs gsum sems dpa' lta bu zhig dgos/ rgyud smin pa'i byang sems kyi 'khor zhes pa rdzogs rim phyag rgya spros bcas man chad mthar phyin pa zhig dgos te / de min na ye shes kyi sku dngos su mi mthong pa'i phyir ro/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i brda' thabs zhes pa sngags tshig brjod pa dang / phyag rgya bca' ba'i brda'i rdzas la ma ltos par dbang bskur zhing / dbang gi sgrom nas rgyud kyang bshad de/dbang don gyi ye shes skyes pa dang rgyud kyi tshig don blor bzung ba sogs dus mtshungs pa'o/ /phyag rdor gyi rgyud bshadapa ni tshar gcig bton nas bka' bsdu mdzad pa'i don/tra ma lnga la dbang de yi sngar nas yod kyang chog laṅka'i yul zhes pa ni kra hor gyi yul gyi bye brag da lta seṅga la yi gling zhes 'dogs par nags kyi rin chen gsungs/ri de la su ma ti ku ṭa'i ri zhes grags par gsungs/ / rgyal po dza'i khang steng du gleg bam babs pa ni gsar rnying yongs grags te gsar ma'i lo tsa pa gzi dga' ba'i rdor rje zhes pas na leñtsa'i gtsug lag khang na bris pa mthong zhing slopodapon brgyabyin sdomopa'i sangasargyasamanyamasbyor gyi 'grelapa lasabashad do/ /phyed sprul longs sku zhes pa rdzogs chen gyi chos skad de/ so skyes kyang skye bas na phyed sprul dang / so skyes gang yin mi skyes bas der skye ba la rdzogs chen skabs lam gyi sgo mthong ba 'od gsal la lhag mthong grub pa zhig dgos la/ yang na bskyed rim mthar phyin nas 'od gsal las rung gi rtogs pa skyes pa zhig dgos pasan longs sku'i zhing zhesabya'o/ /de yang dur khrod me ri 'bar ba lta bu yin no/ /140

zin bris 'jigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /༈ rnal 'byor pa la rna brgyud gtso zhes pa'i don rnal 'byor sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhugs pa de dag rna brgyud kho na min te/ dgongs brgyud yang mdzad nus pa'i phyir ro/ / ༈ lhan cig pa'i 'khor la rigs lnga snang nus kyang rigs drug pa mthong mi nus pa yang yod de/ rigs drug pa phra ba'i phyir ro/ / ༈ sngon dbang thob pa dang / lam bsgom pa'i 'phro sad pa na/ shog ser gyi rkyen gyis gter ston la dbang lung man ngag gi brgyud pa sad pa bzhin no/ / ༈ bu 'bor ba'i lam rim 'grel pa sogs las bla brgyud /brgyad kyang 〉du padma yang yod/ ༈ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang bee ros snga 'gyur/ padma dang gnyag gis bar 'gyur/ bi ma dang rma gnyag gnyis kyi phyi 'gyur gsum las 'dir phyi ma'o/ /me rin chen mchog nas mkhas pa gtsug gyer rnam gnyis dang / de gnyis kyis dar rje dpal grags/ 'di las khams lugs dang dbus lugs gnyis byung / dar rje nas zhing / zhing nas gnub la brgyud pa chu bo gcig dang / gnyag nas slob ma dpal gyi mtha' can brgyad kyi nang tshan sog po dpal gyi ye shes nas gnub la brgyud pa chu bo gcig dang / me gnyag thun mong gi slob ma khu byang chub 'od nas zhing la brgyud de/ zhing la khu nas brgyud pa la bka' mchims phu ma dang / gtsug gyer nas brgyud pa la bka' phyogs skyong ma zhes grags/ des gnub la brgyud pa chu bo gakhrig ༈ thugs sras ka ba bzhi ni/ rdzogs chen gyi ka ba skyo ston shaka ye/ mdo'i ka ba lha rje yang khyad bla ma/ sgyu 'phrul kyi ka ba glan shākya 'od/ phrin sgrub kyi ka ba mda' tig chos shaka go /gtsang gi sgrol phug pa la zhus/ gtsang pa phyis ston la'ang zhus/ khyad par gyi bla ma nye ston chos seng yin/ 'di dge slong dge bzhes chen po rgya'i dbu 141

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/blar yang byon/ dharma shrī nas 'gyur med rgya mtsho'o/ /rin chen rnam rgyal/ khri padma bstan 'dzin/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ chos kyi grags pa ste 'jigs med ngo mchar ro/ /'di skabs kyi chos kyi grags pa ni kun mkhyen phyi ma'i dngos slob sgom chen ngag dbang chos grags yin nam snyam pa zhig thob yig tu 'dug ༈ rnying ma'i rang lugs la/ sngags bla med nang rgyud sde gsum yin de yang gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes lam du byed tshul bstan pa sngags bla med yin/ de lam du byed tshul gyi rim pa sngags bla med ma hā sogs yin/༈ lha mi'i theg pa nas rnal 'byor rgyud man chad dang / thun mong gi lam gyi rim pa bstan pa rnams ni rgyud kyi snyid posnyi don mthar thug ma yin la/ mthar thug gi 'od gsal sogs so/ /de yang mdo sde ba sogs sngo 'dzin mig shes lta bu rang yul don dam bden pa mthong zhing 'khrul ba'i dri mas ma bslad pa'i phyir sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal bar 'dod pa dang / dbu ma pa dag sems kyi chos nyid dgag bya bden grub kyi dri mas ma bslad par sems rang bzhin gnas rigs la sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba zhes 'dod/ 'di'i 'od gsal ni de dag gi dbang du byas pa'i 'od gsal yang yin mod/ der ma zad glo bur kun rtog gi dgag bya'i ngo bo gnyug ma'i shes pa de nyid la med pas na 'od gsal ba ste/ rang gi ngo bo la dri mas ma bslad pa'o// ༈ gnyug ma zhes pa ni glo bur ba min pa'i don yin/ glo bur ba ni dbang shes lta bu dmigs rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i glo bur ba dang / rnam rtog rnams ni bag chags kyis bskyed pa'i glo bur ba dang /brgyal ba dang gnyid sogs 'byung ba sdud pa'i rkyen sogs kyis bskyed pa'i glo 142

zin bris 'jigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /bur ba dang / cir yang mi rtog pa'i rtog med had po kun gzhi lung ma bstan zhes gsungs pa dang / shes pa gsal seng nge ba kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang / bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi ting 'dzin rnams kyang der gtogs par gsungs/༈de kho na nyid ni dper na stong nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug yin pas de kho na nyid ces bshad pa bzhin du 'od gsal gnyug ma 'di'ang sems phra ba mthar thug yin pas 'di las phra na gsal rig rgyun chad par 'gyur bas/ 'di las phra ba'i gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs rgyu med pas na de kho na nyid do// ༈ zab gsul zhes pa'i zab pa ni rtogs dka' ba'i don te/ stong nyid ni dang por thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas rjes dpag tshad mas nges pa bskyed/ de'i rgyun goms pas mthar mngon sum tshad ma'i yul du gyur pa ltar/'di ni ci tsam ring du brtags cing dpyad nas bsgoms kyang gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i kun rtog mched pa las skabs 'di'i dbyings mi rtogs pa'i phyir/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas bzhag thabs sogs kyis rtogs pa las dpyad pas ji bzhin mi rtogs pa'i phyir zab pa'o/ /gsalta ba ni/ gsal ba blo'i mtshan nyid zer ba ltar rang gi yul dbyings gsal bas na gsal ba zhes bya ste/ dbyings gcod pa'i rno cha de la gsal ba zer/ ༈gnyis sto med pa ni dbyings dang rig pa gnyis byas mi rtag bzhin ngo bo dbyer med pa'o/ / ༈ dbyings lam byed bskyed rim zhes mi smra bar bskyed rim gyi skabs na dbyings lam du byed tshul yod ces gsungs/ / ༈ rtsol med rang bzhag gi skabs ma bcos pa'i shes pa'i steng du ma bcos par bzhag tha mal gyi shes pa'i steng du tha mal rang babs su bzhag bzo 143

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/med kyi rig pa bzo med du bsgom/ ༈ nang rgyud yo ga gsum gyi lta ba gtan la 'bebs tshul ni dgag bya gnyis char gyi stong pa'i dbyings gtan la 'beb tshul dgag bya gnyis ni kun rtog dang / bden dngos gnyis yin la/dang po la tshogasabargyad las/ dbang shes lnga spyi skad kyi rtog med yin kyang 'dir rag pa dbang shes zer ba ltar dmigs rkyen glo bur ba'i rten dang bcas pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid kyi kun rtog pa dang / yid shes ni yul gyi ngo bo 'dzin pa dang /nyon yid ni khyad par skye 'gag lta bu 'dzin pa yin la/yid shes la spyi skad kyi rtog bcas rtog med gnyis yod/ kun gzhi ni yid shes phra mo la btag pa yin la gcig tu rtog med dang ma rig pa dang masgom mnyams gtso sems yin pas bag chags kyi gzhi yin/padma dkar po nas bshad pa'i rnal 'byor dang po gsum kyang kun gzhi dngos yin zhing/de ltar skyong ba ni snying thig rang lam gyi gol sa yin pas de lta yud tsam kyang mi bskyang / de lta bu ni gtad so can dang glo bur ba'i lten can yin phyir rten med kyi rig pa sgom pa'i 'gal zla yin/ kha cig gis sgom kyang kun gzhi dang yid shes phra mo yin par mkhas pa gzhan gsungs theg/ /kun gzhi dang kun gzhizhi rnam shes la khyad med gdod ma'i gshis gnyug ma'i bzhugs tshul las gzhan rkyen glo bur pa ting 'dzin gom pa dang / bag chags dang dmigs rkyen sogs rten de 'dra ba la brten pa'i kun rtogs rnams tshogs brgyad du 'du/ bden dngosakyi stong tshul la/bral gzhi 'am stong gzhi dbyings yin la/ de bden dngos dang bral tshul la/dbyingasakyi ngor dbyings rang nyid mi snang ste sor mos sor mo'i rtse mi reg pa bzhin de'i stong gzhi dbyings nyind rang nyid bden dngos kyi stong 144

zin brisa'ajigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /shā dbyings yang yin pas don dang dbyings kyi ngor 'khor 'das kyi chos gang yong mi snang ba ste bral gzhi rang nyid 'khor 'das kyi chos bden pa'i dngos po dang bral ba'i dbyings dang chos nyid yin pa'i go don yin/ dbyings de bden dngos dang kun rtog gi dgag gzhi dang dgag bya de dag dang bral ba'i chos nyid dang chos dbyings su bshad pa gnyis kyi gtso bor gshis chos nyid yin pas phyogs nas go dgos/ dbyings kyi ngor 'khor 'das kyi chos gang yang mi snang ba de dbyings kyi gshis la 'khor 'das kyi chos gang yang ma grub cing med pa'i don jin / de yang ma dag pa'i chos ni ye shes rang dbang gi 'char tshul la gtad med pas/'khor ba'i chos 'di rnams la med snang glo bur ba zhes bya de dag gi phyogs lhade mi mtshungs dbyings de dgag bya gnyis char gyi stong zhes byas tshe/ bram ze chang mi btung zhes pa ltar/dgag pa brtsi ba'i gzhi dbyings kyi steng du dgag bya bcad pa tsam du 'dug kyang bcad tsam gyi cha de mi skyong / gzhi dbyings kyi cha nas skyong zhes ston pa'i dgos cher gtso bor mdzad nas brda sgyi'i don ltar ro/ /dbyings de dang po gsar du nyams su len tshul la/ skyu 'phrul rang gi dgongs pa ni dang po ru shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta bas gtan la phabs te dbyings thos bsam gyis legs par ngo 'phrod pa na/ dbyings de la dngos su mnyam par 'jog pa na/dang po nyid nas dbyings thog tu 'gro mi nus par sems glo bur ba'i steng na bzhag pa tsam las dbyings steng du mi thon/ 'on kyang 'ben legs par mthong nasamada' 'phang na phog 'ong ba dang 'dra bar ci zhig na dbyings thog tu gleb pa de 'ong ba yin no/ /dbyings thos bsam gyis legs par mthong nas sgom pa'i 145

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/nyams len de dbyings kyi nyams len dang dbyings sgom pa yin chog dper na zhi gnas sgom pa na dang po nas zhi gnas 'grub mi nus kyang nam zhig dngos gnas pa 'grub pa bzhin/ dang por dbyings sgom tsam yod nyams su blang tsam nas dbyings rjen la thon mi nus kyang nam zhig glo bur ba'i sgom de yang dag de dbyings dngos mthong 'ong / gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi gshis rjen par mthong tshe stong pa nyid log nas dran mi dgos pa'i gnad ni dang po bzhag thabs kyis nyams su len du nas 'od gsadzal rjen la thon gi bar du dbyings la blta bzhin pa yi na pas 'od gsal mngon dugyur dus rang gi dbyigs la blta ba'i mig sngar nas phye yod pa 'dra ba zhig yin/ de yang 'od gsal de dgag bya gnyis char dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings stong nyid du ngo 'phrod pa'i lta ba brtan po yod dbyings dngos la reg la khad lta bu'i lam bsal nas 'od gsal shar ba na dbyings las gzhan du mi bzur bar byas yod pa'o/de 'dra'i blo gros kyi mig sngar nas phyes de dbyings kyi 'ben mthong ba na/ nyams len gyi mda' 'phen tshul thabs grol gnyis las thabs lam la'ang de dang mtshungs te dbyings la btsan sbyor gyi man ngag zur ba'i rnon pa 'debs bzhin pa'i dus na'ang grol lam gyi skabs kyi dbyingal lta ba'i shes rab kyi mig gis de'i blos zur gcig na sa dbyings la lta bzhin pa lta bu'i gnad gcig med thabs med/ rje'i lugs la rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor sgom pa de stong nyid sgom pa'i ched yin yang de'i rang dus na stong nyid la shes rab kyi spyan gyis bltas te yod pa'ang yin pas/'od gsal shar tshe stong nyid la lta ba'i shes rab kyi spyan log nas dbye mi dgos pa yin 'di ltar mi dgos 46

zin bris 'jigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /pa'i gnad/ yang gsang snying thig ltar na ni ches shin du gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang yod ces gsungs/ sbyang ba sngon song lta bu'i gang zag 'ga' zhig la ha shang ltar ngo sprad kyang 'od gsal ma nor bar shar te dam par gyur tshul yongs grags ltar yod par ma zad/ snying thig dang mthun pa'i dgos pa mthar thug rnyed pade'i gzhal yang gong ltar gyis dbyings kyi dgongs pa dngos la sleb tshul rig pas grub cing khas len dgos/ rdzogs chen rang lugs kyi sems klong gnyis dang man ngag gsang skor man chad kyi lugs la'ang rtsal gyi cha nas ngo sprad pa med kyang rig pas brda yod pas sems rig shan 'byed nus shing rig pa stong nyid du ngo 'phrod pa na bskyed rim dang rtsa rlung la mi ltos par bzhag thabs kyis 'od gsal ba'i rig pa 'byin pa yin yang dang po nas rtsal gnyug ma skyong ba ni med/rig pa dngos kyi steng du 'thon tshe de chig sgril du bskyang ba'i khyung rgong nga'i sbub nas gshogs rtsal rdzog pa ltar thabs shes 'dus pa'irig pa kho na'i steng na sku gnyis 'grub pa'i nus rdzogs yod ces tshig zin gyi bstan na yang snying thigs pas cha de ni drang don du mdzad/ snying thig thun min nas gzhal na spyi khyab sgyu 'phrul des chos nyid kyi dgongs pa rnyed kyang zha/ dka' dka' ltar rnyed pa dang shin tu bul bar dang / rang lugs la lhos nas ni srid mtha' ma khegs pa tsam du 'gyur ro/ /bla ma grub chen gyi gsung ltar rtse gcig gsum gyi mthar rig pa dang dngos la gleb pa zhig spyir mi srid ces 'gog pa min/ padma dkar po dang bla mkhrardzasachen de 'drabade/ yangabasdusangaktasteng ri'i/go'i ོ yasazugaphananamaganod ces khar sang khar nyin zhus/ de 'dra zer tsho ma zhus/ de 'dra de ni de'i 147

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/gol sa yin gsungs so/ / ༈ glo bur ba'i rlung sems kyi cha thams cad la ye shes kyi rlung sems kyi khyab ces pa de da lta'i rnam rtog 'di ye shes dang bsgrim yod pa lta bu la go rgyu min/ rnam rtog de rnam rtog kho na rkyang rkyang yin/ 'o na khyagatshul ji ltar na ye shesa'akhrul ba'i rlung sems su 'ched ces dang thugs rje'i rigartsal gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par shar zhes pa ltar chu chab rom du gyur pa bzhin glo bur rlung sems mtha' dag rig pa ye shes nyid de dang de'i rnam par 'gyur ba las gzhan med pa'i don dang rnam rtog thad kar bcad pa kho nas rnam rtog de dag gi gshis gnyug ma rjen la 'don rgyu yod ces palidon yin/ mdor na ye shesartog med dang rtog pa gnyis cig car du mi 'jug pa'i phan tshun spang 'gal yin/yul snang la ye shes kyi snang ba'i cha yod ces pa'ang da lta'i ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di ye shes kyi snang ba dang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad kyang yin/ ye shes kyi snang ba dag pa de ma dag par snang ba yang yin ma dag pa dag par shar dgos pa yin tshul de shesapa la sbyi sdog cig shes dgos/ ji ltar na snang ba zhes pa de la dag pa'i dang ma dag pa'i snang pa'i cha gnyis dbyer yod ces pa ste shes bya la dbye ba bden pa gnyis yod tshul sogs dang 'dra/ yul snang thams cad la zhes pa/dang mdun gyi bum pa lta bu snang ba'i tshe/ yul snang bum pa de la dag pa ye shes kyi snang cha zhig dang ma dag pa sems kyi snang cha gnyis yod/ ye shes kyi snang cha de ni da lta gab nas yod de yul nyid la gnyug ma dang glo bur ba'i cha gnyis yod pas de tshe gnyug ma'i cha gab nasayod pa dang 'dra/ci zhig yul can gyi glo bur ba'i cha dag ste gnyug ma'i cha rjen la thon tshe yul snang thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i cha dag 148

zin brisa'ajigs med bla ma'i zhal lung /rte'u shes la snang ba'i cha yod kyang gab pa de mngon du gyur tshul lam dang 'bras ba'i ye shes rang snang la 'jug /mdor na yul snang thams cad la gang yang rung bdaper na gzugs lta bu 'char tshe spyir yul snang de la dag ma dag gi cha gnyis yod kyang dag pa'i gzugs snang mngon du 'char ba'i go ma dag pa'i bkag yod thaba'in/ /༈ ma hā'i ma hā ni/sgrub gzhi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang rang gi phung khams stong par sbyang nas stong pa de'i ngang las lhar ldang ba na bdag mdun dbyer med du dkyil 'khor gcig bsgoms nas 'dzab khang dbye ba de 'dra la rtsal 'don pa'o/ /mahā'i a nu ni de gzhir bzhag nas phung khams sogs ye nas sangs rgyas par gtan la phab nas ye nas yin pa la yin par shes pa ltar sgom pa'i lhun 'grub snang stong du shar ba zab mo'i bskyed rim dang lus dkyil bsgom pa la rtsala'adon pa'o/ma hā'i a ti ni de dag gzhir bzhag don dam byang chub sems kyi gshis la ma dag pa'i snang ba yod ma myong pa'i gdod nas rnam dag gi ye shes nyid dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa'o/ / ༈ dbyings dang ye shes lam byed kyi phyogs zhes pa'i dbyings lam byed la/ dbyings ni khams dang rig sogs min pa'i gshis mthar thug dang lam du byed tshul de bzhin nyid kyis ting 'dzin sgom pa yin/ ye shes lam byed la spyir ye shes gcer bu lam du byed tshul yang yod mod/ 'dir dbyings dang ye shes gnyis dang thod rgal zab gsal gnyisadon gcig pa'i rang bzhin gsal ba'i rig pa 'am/ gsal ba dang 'gag med kyi ye shes te zhing sku pho brang gi rnal 'byor lam du byed pa'i bskyed rim gomasapa'o/ /de yang sgyu 'phrul 149

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosasgor/nyid kyi gzhi snang lam byed stong gzugs kyi sku sgrub pa dang thod rgal skabs rang bzhin gsal ba'i ye shes nyid stong gzugs de dang de'i rnam par 'phos pa'am gyur pa'o/ /rig pa nyid stong gzugs la log song ni red/ dbyings dang ye shesaganyis kyi cha la de stong gzugs kyi snang ba ma gtogasamed de'i phyir stong gzugasaji tsam gsal brtan gyi rim pa bzhin ye shes kyang 'gyur ba'i rig pa'i steng stod phur zhes gsungs pa'o/ /༈ rad bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyisagrub pa ni chos thams cad ye nas sangasargyas pa ste 'diskre zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi sangs rgyas yin mi dgos par chosathams cad snang gzhi mthar thug dbyings kyi khams la grub pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i don dang / don dmu jo bo mu skyes pa ni/ gang du ma skyes na glo bur ba'i ngo bor ma skyes pa'o/ /rgyud sde 'di gnyis kyi mtshan gzhir rgyud 'di bzhag chog ༈ 'thob bya rdo rje 'chang thob par 'dod pas/ thabs rags pa bskyed rimagyi sgor zhugs nas/ rang rgyud kyi phung khams skye mched yid ngor lha'i ngo bor dag pa'i bskyed rim phyag rgya spros bcas kyi bar mthar phyin pa'i tshom bu tshogs spyod bsnyen pa nye bsnyen sgrub pa sgrub chen te bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub par byed pa dang / shes rab phra ba rdzogs rim gyi sgor zhugs nas rang rgyud kyi phung khams skye mched dngos su lha'i ngo bor dag pa rdzogs rim phyag rgya spros bcas man chad mthar phyin nas tshom bu tshogs sgrub yan lag bzhis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngosagrub sgrub par byed pa ma hā yo ga'o/ / ༈ che ba brgyad po 'di sngags bla med spyi la mnga' bas bye brag rgyud 'di'i che bar yang 'gyur bas/ de la rgyud thamasi cad 150
