spyi don rin rpā mdzod lde'i zin bris/gi ye shes su 'dus shing rigs lnga yang rigs drug par 'dus pas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid chen po dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rang bzhin no / / zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun ltar na/ phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad rig lngar 'du zhing de dag khyab bdag rigs drug pa la 'du bas na phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag nyidayin pas gcig dang / de thams cad rigs drug pa gcig yin pas du ma dang bral ba ste/ lhag bden spyi yi steng nas go dgos gsungs/ zin bris las/ 'o1ngas sku gcig gi zhid khams bshad pa dang gtan la phabs pas 31ngas sku thams cad kyi zhing khams bshad pa dang gtan la phabs par 'gyur yang chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar min pas gcig dang bral/ sangs rgyasagacig gi phrin las dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las mi 'dra ba med pa sogs kyis du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin zhes so/ /zhal rgyun du/ rtag khyab tu bzhugs pa ཿ lhag bden de gnyis la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnyis su med pa'i — sogs gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ mdun dang rgyab ཿ sogs/bde gshegs rang snang la sku mdun dang rgyab ma grub cing gdul bya'i snang ba la ris med par zhal thal ler gzigs pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes kyis chos kun gzigs pa'i rtags so/ /longs sku'i bdag nyid thun mong mtshan dpe/phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan sogs so gnyis/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang ཿ sogs dpe byad brgyad cu mnga' ba'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi mtshan dpe la'ang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po phyi'i mtshan dpe ni/ ston pa'i thugs me 397

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/long sor rtog bya grub mnyam nyid ye shes bzhi po re re'ang bzhi bzhir phye ba'i bcu drug gi rtsal sems dpa' bcu drug de'i chos dbyings bcu drug las sems ma bcu drug ste mtshan so gnyis dang / sems dpa' bcu drug por ye shes lnga'i rtags rigs lngas dbur brgyan pa'i lha brgyad cu ni dpe byad brgyad cu'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi mtshan dpe ni/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dabs so gnyis mtshan/ mgrin pa'i bcu drug snying ga'i bzhi/ lte ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi'i stong pa'i rtsa bzhi phri lhag drug cu de dag bsdom pas dpe byad do/ /gsum pa ni/ rten nyi zla gnyis kyis dbye bas dga' ba so gnyis mtshan dang / zla ba mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug la ye shes lnga lnga'i ros khyab pa ni dpe byad yin no/ /snying rje chen po dang mi dmigs pa'i shes rab la thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i dmigs med snying rje dang shes rab bo/ /bzhugs tshul dag zhal lung na gsal bas der blta'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen g.yas/ /dril bu padma ral gri g.yon/ /zhes pa ye shes lnga dbyer med pa dang / chos kyi 2bor lo rgyun mi ho pa dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba dang /chos nyid de bzhin nyid la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa dang / mi mthun 'joms pa'i nus pa mthar thug pa rnams rin bzhin mtshon/ zhes dang / rnam thar gsum mthar thug pa brtes pa'i rig pa nyid sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par shar ba'i brdar dkar dmar mthing gis zhal gsum ni / sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'am nyes skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar zhal g.yas dkar/ gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'am/ gdul bya la rjes su chags pa'i brdar g.yon dmar/ thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan 398

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bres/pa'am de bzhin nyid dbyings las slar mi ldang ba'i tshul du mnyam par bzhag pa la 'gyur ba med pa'i brdar dbus mthing ba'o/ /zhes so/ /zhal rgyun du/ rnam thar sgo gsum la sbyar ba de yang rnam 'jog tsam las g.yas zhal gyis stong pa nyid kho na las gzhan gnyis mi mtshon zhes pa'i don min gsungs/ ༈ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po/ zhes thad/ gsung rgyun las/ kun mkhyen chen pos dbus su rigs bdag mtshon byed gdan 'khor lo seṅge byung ba'i phyir dang / yum nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma byung ba'i phyir dang / zhi ba'i mdangs 'phros pa'i khro ba'i skabs su gtso bo buddha he ru ka byung ba'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor 'di yang ye shes rang snang ba gzhi la gtso 'khor ma 'khrugs par 'chad cing snang ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam snang du 'jog rigs te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud kyi sde tshan gcig pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel ba padma dkar po las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad mthing ga dang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid mi bskyod pa dkar po dang zhes so/ /gzhan yang rnam snang gtso bo yin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rigs yin pa dang thun mong min pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs par gnas so/ /gzhan las rnam snang gzugs te sku'i rigs dang mi bskyod pa thugs su bshad pa ni / thun mong ba'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ste/ rigs lnga spyi tsam dang sku'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las gzhan du 'phros pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /zhes dang / zur bas ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje mi bskyod par 'dod de/399

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/glang chen rab 'bog gi rgyud las/ don dam par sems can gyi rnam par shes pa gnas su dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid ces pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi bskyod pa zhes dang / nyi 'od seṅges kun gzhi mi bskyod pa la rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po zhes gnas skabs 'dir bya'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje las rim las/ rnam shes nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems phyir mtshan nyid ma skyes pa/ /mi bskyod yab yum rang bzhin las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi bskyod par bzhed/dogs spong la/ yum dbyings phyug ma ni/ rnam shes yul nam mkha'i khams dang sbyad ba dang / gdan gyi 'khor lo ni/ rigs bdag mtshon byed kyi mtshan ma ma yin gyi/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i phyag rgya ste/ 'grel chung las/ gzhi yang tshad med snyethubor lo ste/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin yin/ /zhes so/ /seng khri yang thugs gtso bor ston pa'i phyir rdo rje'i rigs dang sbyar ba tsam du zad do/ /ye shes ni rgya cher 'grel las/ zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin rnam par shes pa'i phung po yongs su dag pa thugs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor/ zhes so/ /khro bo'i skabs su 'ang / buddha he ru ka gtso bor ma grub ste/ paṇa grub kyi man ngag rnams su rgyud 'khrugs pa bsdebs nas gces bo badzra hre ru kar bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / mi bskyod rgyal po mdun na gnas/ /zhes pa/ rigs drug pa'i mdun dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi lte ba'i steng du gnas so / / gzhan rigs bzhi rnams ni phyogs bzhi na gnas so/ /zhes so/ /dad pas nyan pa'i lha chen rnams/ /zhes pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun la rgyud nyan pas dad pa'i 'khor lha chen rnams sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang / sngags kyi lam gyis ston pa 400

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/dngos su mthong nus pa'i 'khor dang gnyis te/ dper na phar theg tu longs sku'i 'khor la sangs rgyas kyi mthus nyan rang yang yod chog par gsungs pa ltar ram yang na rang snang gzhan snang gi 'khor gnyis yod pa bzhin no/ / ༈ zin bris las/drang srong khros pa log tri pa la lta bu/ mi thung byis pa gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje lta bu / dpal chen rngam brjed che mchog he ru ka lta bu'o/ /gnas tshod la sangs rgyas sprul pa yin par bshad kyang / zhes pa ni/ rū tra rang snang gi 'khor yin pa'i sgrub byed/ dper na 'og min gyi rten brten pa rang snang 'ba' zhig yin pa bzhin du dur khrod me ru 'bar ba'i rten brten pa yang de bzhin dang / rdo rje'i lus la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ mdor na lam 'bras gnyis ka'i skabs na de ltar yod cing / lam 'bras gnyis mtshungs dgos pa'i phyir/ snang tshod ltar bshad na mdo dgongs 'dus dang bka' thang gnyis rgyas bsdus tsam ma gtogs shin tu mthun zhes gsungs/ gnas lnga ma gtogs pa'i 'dod gzugs/'dod khams pas gzugs khams pa dbang du bsdu ba mi 'thad pas 'di rgyud rnam dag min zer ba yod kyang skyon med de spyir de ltar yin kyang / dmigs bsal rigs sngags kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir mi 'gal te/ dper na dmag gi rgyal po rigs sngags kyis dbang du bsdus pa mi 'gal ba bzhin zhes dang /dbang phyug nyer brgyad gdul bya 'dul byed gnyis kar gtogs tshul/ gzhi snang bar do'i skabs su snang ba'i dbang mo dang / 'bras dus su dkyil 'khor gyi khyams na gnas pa'i dbang mo dang / dregs pa can gyi chung ma dur khrod na gnas pa'i dbang mo dang gsum las bar ba 'dul byed tha ma gdul bya yin zhes dang /401

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/thub pa drug tu bzhag go zhes pa'i thad/ dud 'gro 'dul byed du sprul pa'i sku la klu'i rgyal po dang ri dwags dbang po sogs dud 'gro'i rnam pa can dang / yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa sbyin shing dang / lta bu bem po'i rnam can dang / mchog sprul mtshan dpes spras pa'i rnam can sogs mang du yod kyang / dkyil 'khor la 'god dus/ de thams cad dud 'gro 'dul byed kyi sprul skur rigs bsdus nas lha gcig 'god/ de yang bshad ma thag pa de thams cad kyi nang nas sku'i rnam pa'i cha nas mchog tu gyur pa ni mchog sprul rnam can rang yin pas de'i rnam par 'god pa yin/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa de dud 'gro 'dul byed kyi thub pa yin yang / dud 'gro'i rten can gtan nas min no/ /de'i sku'i rnam pa'i ches mchog tu gyur tshul ni/ dag pa'i rnam can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rin po ches gsungs so/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po zhes pa la/ las dbang gis skye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa gnyis las skabs 'dir phyi ma'o/ /sprul sku'i 'khor rnam bzhi/dge bsnyen pha ma/ dge slong pha ma'o /gdams ngag rjes bstan zhes pa/ man ngag khyad par can gsar du ston pa ni gdams ngag dang / gdams ngag thob zin la yang yang nges par bya ba'i phyir/de'i don zhib par slar yang rjes su 'dom pa ni rjes bstan no/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs/ gdul bya yongs su smin/ zhing khams sbyang ba'o/ /sgron ma bkod pa'i dus/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus so/ /snang gsum gyi bag chags sam 'pho ba'i bag chags/ rlung semadra'ikhams phra ba yul la 'pho ba'o/ /gsung rgyun no/ / ༈ zhal rgyun du/ phra mo'i bdud bcom pa ni/ ma rig bag chags 402

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/dang zag pa med pa'i las/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus/ bsam mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba bzhi/ nyon bdud dang / lha bdud dang / phung bdud dang / 'chi bdud phra mo zhes gsungs/ lo chen gyis/ bder 'dus bsnyen yig tu/ phung lnga lhar gsal dag pas phung bdud bcom/ rang rig pa'i rtsal gyis nyon mongs pa ye shes lngar dag pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ de la 'dod lha'i bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing sems nyid skye shi las grol ba lha'i bu'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom zhes gsungs so/ /'di gnyis zhar byung gi gleng gzhir 'gyur zhes pa la/zin bris las/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i khro sprul gnyis kyi gleng gzhi dngos su ma bstan kyang shugs bstan du bzhed pa la dgongs so/ /gleng gzhi nyer len gyi rgyu dang / gleng bslang lhan cig byed rkyen lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / nyi zla byang chub kyi sems zhes pa/ ngo bo ye shes/ rnam pa bdud rtsi'o/ /sems ye shes su bskyed pa zhes pa/ ma dag pa'i sems dag pa ye shes su bskyed pa'o/ /gsung rgyun la 'dir ston pa kun tu bzang po — sogs thad/ 'og min gyi rten can dbang gsum pa bskur yul de la khams dkar dmar yod pa mi 'thad de/ der ma zad 'dod pa'i lha la yang rlung 'pho ba tsam las khams med par gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ dogs spong / khu rdul rlung gsum sogs kyis bstan no/ /lo chen rin po che'i bzhed pas — sogs de'i phyogs nas/ 'dir zhal rgyun du/ 'di rgyud smin pa'i dbang gis bag chags tsam gyis khams drug ldan gyi lus ltar bya ba byed par gsungs/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos grol ba'i thig le'i zhes thad/ bla ma'i gsungs lhan thabs las/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam pa rnams kyis kyang mthar sngags bla med 403

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/lam la ma brten par 'tshang rgya mi nus pabee rgyu mtshan ni/ las mtha' rnam 'byed las/ bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /mgo dang rin chen sogs sbyin pas/ /snang ba rnam gsum ma dag phyir/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod sogs kyis/ /snang ba rnam gsum ma dag phyir/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /sngags kyi sku yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /snang ba gsum po ma dag phyir/ /byang chub dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum po dag pa na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad dang po gnyis kyis phar phyin gyi theg pa dang / de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis bskyed rim tsam dang / rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam gyis snang ba gsum dag par byed mi nus pas bla med byang chub mi 'thob par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ snang ba gsum gyi skabs su gnyis snang gi 'khrul ba yod la/ de gnyis snang zhabrul ba'i bag chags ma lus pa ma dag bar du gtan nas ldog pa med/ des na de gtan ldog gi tshul gyis sbyong ba la lhan skyes kyi bde bas de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs nas sgom dgos shing de yang bla med kyi theg pa las gzhan na med pa'i don no/ /grol ba'i thig le las kyang ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang / /'di don ma rtogs ni raljir/ /ci yang ma yin ting 'dzin gnas/ de tshe bde gshegs kun gyisakyang / /thal byung blo can de bzlog ste/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med rab bstan to/ /nam byed dus na brgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid bsgom pas tho rangs dus/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /zhes sogs 404

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/gsungs so/ /bdag cag gi ston pas dka' spyad kyi mdzad pa la gnas pa'i tshe na nam mkha' gang ba'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis ci yang ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bus bla med mi 'grub bo/ /zhes thal byung gi blo can de bzlog par gsungs pa ni/ rtogs bya chos dang gang zag gi bdag med phra mo chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug yin kyang /rtogs byed yul can gyi blo dag bya glo bur ba'i sems yin pas 'di nyid kyi steng nas stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa ci tsam goms pa byas kyang / snang gsum dri ma phra mo sbyang mi nus pa'i phyir dang / dag bya glo bur ba'i lus sems shin tu dag pa'i rgyal ba'i chos gzugs kyi sku'i dngos kyi nye rgyu byed mi nus pa'i phyir na ci yang ma yin pa dang thal byung gi blo zhes dman pa'i sgras de tsam gyi chog 'dzin bzlog par gsungs pa yin la/ bla med kyi lam gang nas zhugs pa ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med de bstan to/ /zhes nam mkha'i dkyil ltar spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig snang ba gsum gyis bsdus pa'i gnyis snang phra mo'i dri mas dag pa zab pa rim pa bzhi pa'i don gyi 'od gsal dang / de bzhon pa'i rlung gis bsgrub pa'i zab dang rgya che ba gnyis med zung 'jug gi gdams pa bstan par gsungs pa yin no/ /nam phyed dus na brgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid bsgom pa'i tho rangs dus/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ de lta bu'i gdams pa'i don bsgom pas brgyal ba'i tshe kun rtog rags pa dang bral ba ltar/ kun rtog gi spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i don gyi 'od gsal mngon sum du byas pa des chos 405

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/thams cad de kho nyid mngon sum du rtogs shing bsgom par byas pa'i mthus/ lam gzhan gyis sbyang bar mi nus pa'i snang gsum gyi dri ma phra mo shes sgrib kyis bsdus pa de nyid lhag ma med par sbyangs te tho rangs kyi dus na 'od gsal de'i bzhon pa'i rlung gis mi slob zung 'jug gi sku grub nas sangs rgyas par bstan to/ /man ngag snye mar/ mchog tu mthar thug pa la gnas kyang nges par thabs 'di la ltos so zhes brjod par bya ste/ dper na nam mkharabazhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gnang ba'i shes rab kyi dbang las shākya'i mgon po byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa la byang chub thob pa'i ched du mtshan phyed na stong pa bzhi dang / ji ltar yang bcom ldan 'das 'di kho nas rdo rje snying po la thig le mchog ma las dbang bskur ba byin pa sbyin no/ /zhes pa dang mthun par don gyi 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi rim pa grub dgos pa'i de gnyis dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i lam yin pas/ dbang gsum pa sher dbang dang bzhi pa tshig dbang bskur dgos gsungs pa ltar rig pas grub bo/ /ma dag sgyu lus man chad kyi lam rnams bsgom mi dgos te sa bcu pa'i srid pa tha ma des bskal chen grangs med gsum du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa des sgyu lus man chad kyi dod thub pa'i phyir na rgyas sras mthar lam pa des bum dbang nyid kyi lam bskyed rim dang / gsang dbang gi lam dben gsum sgyu lus dang bcas pa nas 'jug mi dgos pas/bum dbang dang gsang dbang yang de la bskur mi dgos par grub bo/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ 7 kun mkhyen chen po'i ngal gso'i spyi don legs bshad rgya mtshor/bdag cag gi ston pa 'tshang rgya tshul ston pa'i skabs su grol ba'i thig le'i lung de 406

spyi don rin rsā mdzod lde'i zin bris/nyid drangs nas bshad pa ltar byas tshe byang sems mthar lam pa de bla med du 'jug tshe dbang gsum pa nas 'jug pas chog dgos par mngon yang bka' sde zur ba'i bshad srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis gsang dbang nas 'jug dgos par gsungs pa gnyis mi mthun par snang ba 'di ci zhe na/ grol ba'i thig le la sogs pa /'di gsar phyogs dang mthun par bshad pa yin/ mchan// gzhung chen po gzhan gyi gsang dbang gi lam dben gsum sgyu lus dang bcas pa yin pas gong bshad ltar rgyal sras mthar lam pa de mi slob lam du 'jug pa la dbang gsum pa'i lam rim pa bzhi pa don gyi 'od gsal las 'jug pas dbang gnyis pa nas 'jug mi dgos par bzhed la/ rgyud 'di'i bshad sgol gyi dbang du byas tshe gsang dbang gi lam rdo rje lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i rang lus thabs ldan gyi lam rnams yin pas/ mthar lam pa des kyang rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum la dmigs pas gnad du bsnun dgos pas/ gsang dbang dgos par bzhed kyang /rdzogs rim gyi lam la 'jug mtshams la mi 'dra ba chen po min no/ /zhes 'gal med du 'chad pa'o/ /yang na ston pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas khams dkar dmar gyi rdzas gnang ste ched du brjod pabee 'bras dbang dang gsang dbang chos mthun pas gsang dbang gi tha snyad du mdzad pa ma gtogs gsang dbang dngos ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i lan snga ma dang 'di gnyis gang bder dpyad dgos gsungs/ ༈ dbang phyi ma gnyis la yang dogs pa bcad rgyu yod pa des shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ mkhas grub chen po gzhan gyis bzhed pa'i dbang gsum pa ni phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la snyoms par zhugs pa las las rlung dbu mar 407

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi stong nyid dang sbyar ba'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de nyid dbang gsum pa dang / de'i dus su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum kyi skur gsal ba dang sems bde stong dbyer med du song ba gnyis dus gcig tu tshogs pa de dper byas te/ thugs bde chen des stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa sku dag pa sgyu ma'i sku mtshan dpe bzhin lag gi rnam pa can du dngos gnas la grub pa gnyis dus gcig tu tshogs shing dbyer med du song ba'i slob pa dang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku thugs zung 'jug de nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad pa de nyid bzhi pa tshig dbang du ngos 'dzin par mdzad la/ rgyud 'di'i bka' srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis dbang gi dus su slob bu rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba las thig le yas babs kyi dga' ba bcu drug dbang gsum pa dang / mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug dbang bzhi pa dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang zhes/ dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba'ang de gnyis kyi lam ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra bas yin pa'i phyir te/ chen po rnams kyis bzhed pa la dbang gsum pa'i lam ni rim pa bzhi pa'i don gyi 'od gsal dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lam zung 'jug gi lam yin par bzhed pa dang / rgyud 'di'i bka' srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis dbang gsum pa'i lam gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi lam dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lam 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sngags bla med kyi 'phags lam de yin par bzhed pa la shin tu mthun pas/ don gyi gnad la 'gal ba cher med do/ /'chad gang bder dpyad gsungs pa las rang rang gi bzhed gzhung 408

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/rnams dang shin tu mthun pas dbang gnyis lam 'jog lugs mi 'dra bas yin no/ /zhes pa 'di 'thad pa yin snyam/ ༈ zin bris las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhi ba'i zhabs la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsungs pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gdams pa 'jam dpal zhal lung / de'i 'grel ba slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim ston pa sgrub thabs kun bzang / rdzogs rim ston pa grol ba'i thig le ste ye shes zhabs lugs gsungs/klu sgrub kyis gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba mdo byas dang / mdo bsres gnyis te / snga ma rtsa rgyud kyi tshig re re nas sbyar ba med/ phyi ma la yod/ de'i rdzogs rim ston pa la dpal rim pa lnga pa ste 'di la gsang 'dus 'phags lugs gsungs/gsung rgyun las/ dbang gi lam 'jog tshul mi 'dra bas zhes pa/ gsar rnying gnyis kas bum dbang tshogs lam du 'jog tshul 'dra yang / gsar phyogs nas gsang dbang sbyor lam/ sher dbang mthong lam/ tshig dbang sgom lam du 'joga'adir ni gsang sher gnyis ka sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du 'jog pa'o/ /dbang phyi ma gnyis la dogs gcod ces pa/ grol thig ltar/ dbang phyi ma gnyis mthong lam yan chod nas 'jog pa khams lugs yin no/ /spyor lam nas 'dzog pa zur lugs so/ /zhes gsungs/ zhal rgyun la/ bdag byin rlabs kyi rtsa thig rlung la gnad du bsnun pa'i lam gsang dbang gi lam dang / gzhan lus la brten nas yas babs kyi lam dang / mas brtan dbyer med bde ba chen po'i dbang gi lam du bzhag pas/ gsang dbang gi lam 'di ltar na khyab che bas khyad par yod ces gsungs/409

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/༈ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i yon tan mdzod kyi rang 'grel las sa bcu'i mthar sngags la 'jug par gsungs pa'i don/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi dang brgyad/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang po gsum dang bcu gcig gi bar la gdul bya drangs ba'i phyir rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa bcu gcig tu btags pa yin pas/ sngags kyi theg pa la rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi pa nas 'jug par mtshan brjod kyi lung gis sgrub te gsungs/ de bzhin du mkhan bo yon tan dga' bas yon mdzod 'grel ba las lung rigs du mas sgo nas sgrubasayod la/ khyad par spyod bsdus kyi 'grel ba dang / rnam snang mngon byang sogasal brten nas sgrubs pas dang po ni/ gang tshe tha ma'i drod gyur nas/ /bzod pa chos mchog bar du ni/ /rab 'bring spyor ba bcu gnyis te/ /rab tu dga' ba bcu gsum pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / rigs pa yang so skyes 'ching ba kun ldan gyi rgyud la sngags lam skye na/ 'phags pa sa thob pa'i rgyud la mi skye zhes bshad na ha cang thal ba dang / der ma zad phyi 'gyur chos skad nang mthun par smra ba dag kyang so skye'i rnal 'byor dang / 'phags pa mthon po'i rnal 'byor stobs nus che chung gi khyad par gnam sa lta bur khyad zhugs pa la dod thub byed pa ha cang thal zhes nang phan tshun dgag pa sogs rnam grangs mang po'i sgo nas bkag ste 'phags lam nas sngags kyi ye shes nyid mngon du gyur bar gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yang / thun mong gi 'dod pa'i sangs rgya tshul la sbyar te/ ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang / /sogs drangs/ thun min ltar na theg chen mdo ltar na/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ dpa' bo chen po 410

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/thabs mkhas nyid/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ /sogs kyis sgo nas grangs med mang po'i spong nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa dang / mi pham chos rjes yang /'phags lam nas sngags kyi ye shes nyid brnyes par gsungs pa sogs bsgrigs nas/ thun mong dang thun min gyi khyad par rang lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa gzur gnas rnams kyis dpyad par zhu'o/ /e ma ho/ ye nas gsang ba'i chos —sogs zhes pa'i don ni ma rtog pa'i 'gro ba la skyo ba'i tshul gyis e ma ho zhes rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid la 'bras bu che ba'i yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub kyang / de'i don thog ma nyid nas ma rtogs pas ye nas gsang ba'i chos so / / de nyid sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos thams cad kyang 'bras bu mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gnas la phyin ci log gi shes pas bslad nas rang gi rang bzhin ma rtog pa ni rang bzhin gyi gsang ba'o/ /gnas lugs de yang yul sems dang rgyu 'bras la sogs pa gnyis chos thams cad las ngo bo nyid kyis grol te yul tu byar med kyang ma rtog pas de ltar blta ba ni rab tu gsang ba'o/ /de yang sems nyid las gzhan zhig gud du yod pa min kyang sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pas bsgrib te rang la gnas pa gzhan las 'tshol ba ni shin tu gsang ba ste/ de ltar gsang ba bzhis chod nas ma rtog pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung bar rigs zhes zhus pace(/ /༈ yang zin bris las/ gnyug ma'i steng na 'bras chos thams cad ye rdzogs su gnas pa ngo ma shes pa ye gsang / sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos kun ye shes rang snang las mi gzhan kyang glo bur 'khrul rtog gi dbang gis de 'dra'i rang bzhin ma 411

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/shes pas rang bzhin gsang ba/ snang ba de thams cad gnyis chos mtha' dag dang bral yang de ltar ma rtog pa rab gsang / chos rnams sems nyid las gzhan du med kyang 'khrul ba'i dbang gis gzhan du 'tshol ba shin tu gsang ba'o/ /smin ma g.yo ba sogs kyis spyan 'gyur ba/ phyag skyong ba/ sku'i gzing bstod pa/ 'od zer spro ba rnams so/ /zin bris las/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i ye shes yul dang bcas pa ye nas rnam par dag pa'am sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang / gang gis gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs lam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dang / ji ltar gnad du bsnun pa'i tshul lta bu'i de'i khyad chos legs par shes na sogs la sbyar/ 'ching grol med pa'i gnas lugs sogs thad zhal rgyun du/ sems kho na gtso bo yin par lan gcigaḥ sogs skabs/ theg chen mdo las/ sems 'dul ba ni bde ba 'dren/ /sems 'dul ba ni legs pa ste/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du gyur/ /zhes dang / sems dge mi dge'i dbang gis/sems dmyal mtho ris 'jig rten na/ /mtshon dang rin chen shing bzhin no/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las kyang / sems spangs nas ni las kyang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / yid bzhin mdzod las/ sems kyis 'du byed sems kyisalas kun byed/ /sems la snang zhing sems kyis btags pas na/ /'khrul ba'i sems gdul slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rtsa ba sems la thug pa'i sgo nas las bsags/ des gnas ris tha dad pa'i lubor ba dag snang ba dang / dad pa sogs yid dge ba'i dbang gis rnam byang phyogs yang 'byung ba yin pas thams cad las sems gtso bo yin 412

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/par gsungs/ phra ba'i sems zhes pa tshogs brgyad las 'das pas so sems kyi rdo rje zhes pa/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje chos bdun dang ldan pa nyid sems can gyi rgyud la 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa nyid yin la/ de ltar rtag tu bzhugs pa yang rang 'joms byed kyi gnyen po med pas yin no/ /zhes dang / 'od gsal zhes pa/ phar theg tu stong pa nyid la bdag 'dzin gyis dmigs tshul dag pas bdag 'dzin dang de'i rtsa ba can gyi nyon mongs kyi dag pas na 'od gsal zhes zer/ 'dir gnyug ma'i ye shes nyid chags sdang rmongs sogs sgrib pa'i ngo bor gtan nas skye mi srid pas sangs rgyas nas sems can bar skad cig tsam yang bzang ngan med pas na 'od gsal zhes btags pa dang / rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes pa'ang lam bsgom stobs lta bu'i bde chen gyi ngo bor skyes pa lta bu min par gdod nas ngo bo bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du lhan cig skyesapas lhan skyes dang sems can thams cad kyi 'char gzhi sems dang lhan cig tu bzhugs kyang rang nyid sems las ma skyes pas lhan skyes la tre(gas pa'i zhes pa'i skabs/ bsdusan ma'i ye shes dang / ye grol rig pa sogs mtshan mang du yod la/ dang po'i don rkyen gyis bcos bsgyur byas pa min par yin lugs la gnyug ma zer ba dang /chos thams cad rang snang du rig pas na rig pa dang / spang bya'i gtan ma bcing bas ye grol sogs su btags par gsungs/ bcing grol med pa'i zhes pa/sems rags pa rnams las nyon sdug bsngal gyi ngo bor skye bzhin pa'i skabs na'ang 'od gsal ba'i ye shes kyi ngo bo la cung zad ma sbag ma bslad par bzhugs pas na gang gis ma bcing bas na da grol yang mi dgos pas bcing grol med pa 413

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/ste / byams pa mgon pos/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /ye shes rang gi gnas lugs stong pa nyid ces pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun du/ rig pa nyid mngon du gyur na chos kyi dbyings rang stobs kyis mthong bya dang mthong byed kyi spros pa med par mngon sum gzigs pas na rang rig pa zhes brjod do/ /byang chub sems zhes pa'i thad/ rgyud 'di nas bstan pa'i ye shes de bsgrib pa'i dri mas gtan ma gos pa dang gsal ba sku dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pas byang chub dang / ngo bo ye shes yin pas sems zhes brjod la/ kun rdzob byang sems nyid byang chub min zhing byang chub 'dod pa tsam yin par gsungs so/ /bden pa gnyis la spyir 'jog tshul mang yang zhes pa/ bye mdo dang dbu sems phyi rgyud rnams so/ /bde gshegs zur chung bas/ chos rnams sogs thad/ cho 'phrul chu chab rom lta bu la go dgos/ gnas tshul ye shes yin kyang snang tshul phyin ci log tu song ba chab rom chu min yang gshis chu yin pa bzhin no / / gsungs/ ༈ 'dir bstan gnyug ma'i sems don gcig pas dgongs gzhir ma zad brjod bya yang 'di kho na yin zhes bzhed la/ zhes pa ni/ yid bzhin mdzod 'grel padma dkar po'i rim khang bco brgyad pa'i 'grel bar/ don 'di mdo sde'i yang bka' tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs su gtso bor gsungs pa la/ rgyud kyi dngos gzhi yin pas/ 'dir de'i rang bzhin rtogs par byed pa ni rgyud bla ma'i mya ngan 'das pa dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po la sogs pa'i gnas ji lta ba bzhin bshad pa las/ gnyug ma'i 'od gsal de nyid sems can gyi rgyud la rang chas su yod pa'i nges don/ rgyud bla ma dang chos 414

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/dbyings bstod pa bzhin du bshad pa ni/ sa 'og gter dang bum nang mar me dang / /pad nang sku 'drar mkhas pas shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa drangs ba dang / gang 'dir ston pas chos kyi mdzod gsungs pa/ /kun gyi snying po 'od gsal rtse mo'i lam/ /lhun grub gzhi yi gnas lugs yin zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi bka' tha ma dang / man ngag tu lhun grub gzhi yi gnas lugs 'di mchog tu bsngags pas shes par bya'o/ /zhes sogs theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod dang / grub mtha' mdzod dang / nges don shing rta chen mo sogs nas tshul de dang mthun par gsungs so / / ༈ sngags kyi khyad chos yin zhes bzhed do/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ nang rang rig 'gyur med la de bzhin nyid du byas pa ni snying po'i mdo dang rgyud bla ma sogs de dag gi dgongs 'grel rnams dang mthun yang 'dir rang rig de bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas pa ni/ bla med rgyud kyi khyad chos yin no snyam du sems te/dus 'khor las/ srid gsum phra rags gzugs min 'dir ni rnam par shes pa'o de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid med de/ /sangs rgyas shes rab gang du gnas pa ma yin zhes pa'i tshig ni sangs rgyas pa rnams ston par 'gyur/ /gang gis 'gyur med dang bral mi rnams kyis ni stong pa nyid de bzung nas stong par blta byed pa/ /de nas gtso bo gang gi 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi theg par bstan/ /zhes so/ /zur 'debs las so /mi pham rin po ches rgyud bla'i dogs bshad/ sprin dang rmi lam bzhin chos thams cad stong par gsungs nas/ de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi chos nyid kyi dbyings de bde gshegs snying po yon tan ye ldan gyi khams su gsungs 415

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/pa'i dgos pa ci zhes dris pa la/ sems zhum sogs nyes pa lnga spangs pa'i don du gsungs/ de ltar gsungs pa de 'dra'i khams yon tan med kyang yod pa'i rdzun tshig drang don nam nges don gang yin na/ drang don yin na rgyud bla'i rang tshig dang dngos su 'gal/ nges don yin te byang chub tu sems bskyed nas phyir mi ldog pa 'jigs med rtag pa'i lam theg chen rtogs rigs thun min yin no/ /de yin par yang / yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyi sogs kyis bshad de/ las nyon rnam smin gyis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba'i chos rnams dbyings la ye nas mi ldan te rang bzhin rnam dag yin pas 'bral rung dang / zag med mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi yon tan thams cad mkha' go 'byed dang / nyi ma la 'od bzhin 'bral mi rung bar rang gi chos nyid la ldan te/ gshegs snying ni stong rkyang tsam min te/stong nyid 'od gsal yin/ de chos thams cad kyi ye thog gzhi yi gnas lugs yin/ zung 'jug bden pa dbyer med kyi gnas lugs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yin la/ de ngo bo nyid kyis srid zhir mi gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan lhun grub tu yod pa/ de rtogs pas theg chen lam gyi yon tan thams cad 'byung ba yin no/ /las nyon rnam smin gyi phra ba gang zad phan chad spang bya gtan med pa ni ma rig bag chags kyi sa sogs bzhi yin/ de spang ba ni sangs rgyas kho na'i sa yin la/ de bzhi spang na mthar thug gi yon tan stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya mtsho mngon du 'gyur ba ni dbyings kyi yon tan nyid mngon du gyur ba yin pas/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs kho na yin gyi nyan rang sogs kyi ma yin te/ sangs rgyasakyi yon tan dang dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na khyi phag 416

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/sogs sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rgyud la stobs bcu'i ye shes yod dam zer na / stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi yon tan de'i rgyud kyi gshegs snying la ye nas yod de/kho rang gi chos nyid kyi yon tan yin pas khams yod na yon tan yod mod kyi mngon du mi 'gyur te/ ral gri la gcod pa'i bya ba yod kyang shub tu chud pa la gcod pa'i bya ba mngon gyur du med pa dang / me long la gzugs brnyan 'char rung gi yon tan yod kyang sgrom du bcug pa la mngon du mi 'char ba dang 'dra ste/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i rgyud la yod pa'i sgrib pas khams gsum gyi yon tan mngon du mi snang ste/ der ma zad de'i rang sems kyi chos nyid rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yod kyang mngon du mi 'gyur na yon tan ci la mngon/ de'i phyir mngon gyur du med pa 'di la bsam nas stobs bcu skye rung gi rgyu tsam yod kyi dngos su med zer ba yod pa'ang dpyad tshul de'i dbang du de ltar rung mod/ skye rung gi rgyu de 'dus byas sems kyi cha yin na sems yin tshad stobs bcu skye rung du sgrub dka' la/ sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas sbyangs stobs kyis sems nyid rang gis byed pa yin na/ 'di 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings kyi yon tan yin pas/ smin pa'i rgyu ru mi rung ngo / /'di lta bu'i khams de sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gnyug sems gsungs pa de yin/ de nam yang rgyun chad pa med la ngo bo stong pas dmigs mtshan gang yang med kyang stong rkyang min te mtshan ma med pa'i rang 'od gsal ba yin no/ /sgrib pa ma zad pa'i sems rgyud kyi gshegs snying la stobs bcu'i ye shes mngon gyur du med pa ni bdag cag kyang 'dod mod/ bla med chos kyi yon tan dbyings de la 417

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/med pa min kyang / mngon du mi 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khams rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ye ldan min na/ de 'dra'i khams de yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs su mi 'grub ste/ stong rkyang bzhin no/ /des na chos dbyings 'od gsal lam/ rang byung ye shes sam gnyug sems 'od gsal lam/ bde gshegs snying po zhes pa rnams don gcig ste/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin te/sgrib bcas kyi rgyud la yod tshe sangs rgya rung gi rigs dang sangs rgyas tshe mngon gyur yin/ sangs rgya rung yin kyang 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid la snga phyi'i khyad par gnas tshul la med de ngo bo 'gyur med yin pas so/ /snang tshul la gnas gyur ba'i tha snyad brjod rung ngo / /de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs yod par bstan pas nyes pa lnga spangs nas bla med byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /nyes pa lnga po gshegs snying sems can thams cad la yod par ma thos pa las byung / mthar thug theg gcig 'grub pa'i gnad 'di yin la/ rdo rje theg par sems nyid ye sangs rgyas pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ ༈ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang de/ khres bya thams cad rnam kun stong ngo zhes/ /gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la bskur/ /bdag cag lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don/ chos rje mi pham pa'i phyag mchan las/ mi brtan cing rang bzhin med pa sprin dang / nyams su myong yang rang bzhin med pa rmi lam dang / rnam par snang yang rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i 418

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/gzugs brnyan bzhin bka' bar ba yum rgyas 'bring sogs dang der shes bya thams cad ni rnam kun tu stong pa'o zhes gsungs nas/ yang 'khor lo tha ma 'dir rgyal ba rnams sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi snying po gdod nas lhun grub tu yod ces ci ste gsungs te yod med mi 'gal lam/ zhes dang / yang khams de 'phags pa mchog gis kyang rtogs par dka' na byis pa rnams la de bstan pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ de yi lan nyid bstan pa'o/ /de gnyis mi 'gal te/ sngar gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos rnams la bden pa med par gsungs pa dbyings ngo bo stong pa'i cha nas bstan pa yin la/ 'dir bde gshegs snying po yod par gsungs pa yang ngo bo bden par yod ces gsungs pa ma yin te/ rig pa ye shes rang bzhin gsal ba'i cha nas bstan pas de gnyis mi 'gal bar ma zad gcig grogs su gcig 'char bas zung du 'jug pa dang / dgos pa khyad par can lnga'i ched du yod par bstan pa dang / lnga gang zhe na/ rang la sems bskyed skye ba'i gegs don dam pa'i dbyings rang la yod par ma shes nas byang chub bsgrub par mi nus snyam du sems zhum pa dang / lam la mi spro ba'i nyes pa dang / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gegs gzhan rgyud la gshegs snying yod par ma shes na sems can 'di dag dman no snyam du dman la brnyas pa mi gus pa'i nyes pa dang / yang dag pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa〉 shes rab kyi gegs rang gzhan kun la btagags snying yod par ma shes nas bcos ma glo bur gyi dri ma dbyings la gdod nas med pa la yod par sgro btags te yang dag par min par 'dzin pa'i nyes pa dang dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i yon tan rnams yod pa la med par snyam te yang dag 419

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/chos la skur ba 'debs pa'i nyes pa dang / bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i gegs bdag gzhan rang bzhin chos dbyings mnyam par ma shes pas bdag la chags pa lhag par 'phel ba'i nyes pa ste skyon nam nyes pa lnga gang zag gang dag la yod pa de dag de spang gsungs pa yin no/ /rin po ches gter chen bla ma la gsungs pa ni/ sems zhus : sogs don la/ bdag kyang bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems dang ldan pas/ dri ma glo bur ba sbyongs ba'i thabs la bslab na bla med byang chub gdon mi za bar 'thob nus so snyam nas zhum pa skrong ba dang / rgyud nyes byas chen pos zil gyis mnan cing nyon mongs 'chol nyog tu spyod pa'i sems can rnams kyang gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal kyi snying po can du gnas pas nges par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro snyam nas sems can dman pa la brnyas pa spong ba dang / 'bral rung glo bur ba'i sems la mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du 'gro ba'i shes rgyud gnyug mar zhen pa'i sgro 'dog spong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi gzhir gyur cing mos pa lan re skyes pas kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog pa'i sems kyi gnad gsang mthar thug gzhan yod pa la/ da lta rang cag la mngon du gyur ba'i sems kyi pha rol na de 'dra gang yang med do zhes skur ba 'debs pa spong ba dang /bdag gzhan snod bcud bde sdug sogs glo bur gyi 'khrul snang ci tsam shar yang sems kyi gnyug ma'i gshis la mnyam pa nyid du shes nas bdag la lhag par chags pa'i skyon bsal te zhen med kyi gnad dang ldan pa'i dgos pa dang lnga/zhes pa 'phral gtam tsam mo/ /'phags pa thogs med kyi rgyud bla'i 'grel bar/420

spyi don rin wo mdzod lde'i zin bres/sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod sogs drangs nas nyan rang gis kyang bde gshegs snying po phyogs gcig mthong bar bshad pa/ khyod ltar na nyan rang rnams kyang lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtogasapas gsang sngags par khas len dgos so/ /zhe na nyan rang gis sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gzigs shing / sems kyi nang na gshegs snying yang yod pas de tsam la bshad rung ste chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong na chos thams cad mngon sum du mthong mi dgos da dung yid bzhin mdzod 'grel dang shing rta chen po las g.ya' chod/ ༈ bla ma rin po che'i gsungs zur 'debs las/ sprin dang rmi lam sogs don 'khor lo bar bar nyon mongs sprin dang / zag bcas kyi lasarmi lam gyi longs spyod dang /nyer len gyi phung po sgyu ma dang / sprul ba ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang ma grub pas snang ba tsam du gsungs nas yang 'khor lo tha ma 'dir sems kyi rgyud 'dir sangs rgyas kyi snying po 'di lta bu yod par gsungs pa mi 'gal lam ci zhe na/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ sems zhus sogs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod pa 'di ma mthong bar bdag ni yon tan dang bral zhing nyes skyon gyi phung po chen po yin pas bdag lta bus byang chub ga la 'iX/ba snyam nas sems zhus pa dang /bdag nyid la byang chub kyi sems skyes kyang / byang sems ma skyes pa'i sems can gzhan la dman pa'i 'du shes kyis khyad du gsod pa dang / bdag gzhan gyi rgyud 'di mtha' gcig tu nyes skyon can du bden par sgro 'dogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i chos sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes mtha' dag gi sems can gyi rgyud 'di stong 421

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chos skor/par bzung nas skur ba 'debs pa dang / bdag la chags pa'i dbang gis bdag ni gzhan las lhag go zhes nga rgyal skyes pas nyes pa lnga spang ba'i rnam gcod kyi dgos pa'i ched du/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi rgyud na gnyug ma'i 'od gsal sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod lta bu de yod par ston pa'i man ngag gi mchog de bstan pas/ spro dang ston pa bzhin gus dang / /shes rab ye shes byams chen skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag nyid kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na nges par 'tshang rgya'o snyam du dga' zhing spro ba dang / sems can gzhan mtha' dag kyang gshis sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid yin no snyam du ston pa bzhin du gus pa dang /ma dag 'khor ba'i phung khams 'di dag thams cad kyang dag bya glo bur ba 'bral rung kho na'i bdag nyid du shes pa'i shes rab dang / rang bzhin rnam dag gi dbyings 'od gsal bas sems can thams cad la khyad med par khyab par nges pa'i ye shes dang / bdag gzhan thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i bdag nyid du mnyam par shes pa'i byams pa chen po skye ba de yongs gcod kyi dgos pa lnga dang ldan par bstan no/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bar yang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni skye ba'am/ na ba'am 'chi 'pho ba ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul las 'das pa'o/ /rtag pa/ brtan pa/ zhi ba/ g.yung drung zhes gsungs pa sogs gshegs snying rtag brtan tu lung dang 'grel tshig du mar bstan kyang / de'i don shing rta chen por ni/ dri ma med pas gtsang ba/ 'pho 'gyur med pas bdag dam pa/ dus thams cad du gnas pas rtag pa/ sdug bsngal thams 42paṃ

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/cad pa'i 'khor bar lhung yang sdug bsngal gyi zil gyis mi gnon pas phyir bde ba'i pha rol phyin pa ste zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi ngo bo dri mas ma bslad cing yon tan ye rdzogs su yod pas ye shes de nyid bzang ngan sna tshogs su 'gyur ba med pas brtan pa/ dus nam yang rgyun chad pa med pas rtag pa/ dri mas ma bslad pas zhi ba/ skye 'chi bsgres rgud dang bral bas g.yung drung gi bdag nyid du yin pa dgongs pa yin no/ / ༈ de bas kyang ches bshad dka' ba 'ga' zhig zhes pa'i thad/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bar/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin yongs su dag pa lta ba'i gnad yin pa ni 'di ltar gang gi sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po cung zad mthong ngo zhes gsungs pas/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin kyi ye shes kyis mthong bar 'dod do/ /de skad du/ sprin mthong mamakha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blo gros can/ /blo mig dag pa'i 'phags rnams kyis kyang thams cad mthong ma lags/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod chos sku gang dag blo gros mtha' yas pa/ /shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab pa de dag gis kun mthong / /zhes pa'i thad du shing rta chen po las/ gnas lugs ma mthong ba'i skyes bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa rnams dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas theg pa chen por mos pa dang / sa la ma zhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyis mos pas don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa dang / sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pas phyogs gcig tsam rtogs la/ ji lta ba bzhin du ni sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan gyis mi mthong ste zhes gsungs/ ༈ yang zin bris las/ sprin dang rmi lam sogs nasagasungs zhes sher phyin gyi mdo stong 423

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/phrag brgya ba la sogs pa de dang / der shes bya thams cad sprin dang rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin du rnam pa thams cad du rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i stong pa zhes glo bur ltar gsungs nas/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa 'dir rgyal ba rnams sems can thams cad la sems kyi rang bzhin nam gnyug mar gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs te gsung mi rigs par thal/glo bur ba yin pa dang rang bzhin nam gnyug ma yin pa gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/zhes pa'i rtsod pa dang / sems can thams cad la de 'dra'i bde gshegs snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs te dgos pa med par thal/ byis pa rnams la bstan yang rtogs mi nus pa'i phyir te/ dkon mchog gsum po 'di yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de la rnam bzhi go rim bzhin/ /rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khu1ba/ /ces pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes de ltar bstan pal dgos pa med par rtsod pa'i lan du sems zhum sems can dman la sogs gsungs/ zhes gsar du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gegs bdag la sangs rgyas kyi rigs sam sa bon med pas bla med byang chub 'thob mi nus snyam du sems zhum pa dang / byang sems kyi spyod pa sgrub pa'i gegs sems bskyed pa kha cig bdag gis byang chub 'thob nus la semasacan gzhan gyis mi nus snyam pa'i sems can dman pa la brnyas pa dang / gnas lugs sam gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi don rtogs pa'i gegs gnyug ma'am yang dag min pa'i glo bur ba la yang dag par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs dang / yang dag pa'i chos gnyug sems rang bzhin gyi 424

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/rnam par dag pa med do 'e/sa skur ba 'debs pa dang / sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu bdag gzhan brje ba'i snying rje chen po'i gegs dang gces 'dzin dbang gis bdag la chags pa lhag par yod pas skyon lnga po de dag spang nas gsal du sems bskyed pa sogs kyi yon tan de dag bskyed pa'i don du sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung gi gshegs snying sems can thams cad la yod par gsungs so/ /mdo phyi mar bstan pa'i gnyug sems yul yul can gyi spros pa dang bral ba de nyid mdo snga mar bstan pa'i spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings yin pas na snga phyi mi 'gal bar shes par byos shig ces pa ste/ mdo phyi mar bstan pa'i rang bzhin nam gnyug ma ni/ gnyug sems kyi dbyings mthar thug dang / mdo snga mar bstan pa'i glo bur ba ni kun nyon gsum gyi mtshon pa'i kun rtog yul dang bcas pa yin pas mi 'gal bar gsungs te/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyi stong sogs gsungs pas so/ /gsung rgyun las/ gshegs snying la rtag pa'i chos nyid ces pa/ gsar phyogs nas rtag brtan ther zug gi rnam pa ma yin par rgyun gyi rtag pa la go dgos/phar theg nas sems rags pa'i steng nas stong nyin sgom pas ngo bo nyid sku'i nyer len gyi rgyu dang / sems rags pa'i steng nas tshogs bsags pas gzugs sku'i nyer len gyi rgyur 'dod pa'o/ /de bas ches bshad dka' ba zhes pa/ gsar phyogs kyi gshegs snying stong nyid la bzhed pas de ni nyan rang la'ang rtogs pa yod/ de lta na nyan thos kyi stong nyid bstan pa'i sde snod rnams gshegs snying ston pa'i sde snod yin par thal zhe na nyan rang gis rtogs pa'i stong nyid ni skar ma'i 'od lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyi nyi ma'i 425

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba de gnyis mi 'dra'o zhes so/ /mi pham chos rjes bzhed pa ltar na / byang sems kyi gshegs snying tshes gcig gi zla ba cha shas mthong ba lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyis yongs rdzogs mthong ba'i khyad par gsungs pa 'og nas bshad par 'gyur ro/ /zin bris las/ rnam pa gcig tu na zhes pa nas zhib tu dpyad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar rin po che nyid kyi dgongs pa red gsungs/ da lta gson lus la gnas dus kyang zhes pa'i thad/ zhal rgyun du/ tshig don mdzod sogs las bshad pa ltar gyi sems kyi gnas ngo bo ro skyang bzhon pa las rlung dang 'grogs pa'i sems rnams/ rig gdangs mi 'phye bo/ las rlung rta long ba zhon nas yul bgrod pa'i dpes mtshon pa'i don rig gdangs nyid las gzhan min la/ gal te rig gdangs dang ma 'grogs na yul shes pa'i bya ba sogs gang yang mi byed par gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ chos thams cad rtog pa'i cho 'phrul/ rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal gyi cho 'phrul/ da lta nas rnam rtog thams cad kyi srog na 'od gsal nyid bzhugs pa de nyid bla ma'i man ngag gis ngo sprad de lam du byed pa rgyud 'di'i khyad chos/ da lta'i rtog pa thams cad kyi srog na 'od gsal yod na/ 'od gsal rnam rtog gnyis skud pa dkar nag bsgrim pa ltar yod dgos pas shes rgyud gnyis su thal lo zhe na/ dper na chu grang bas bcur te chab rom du song ba'i sra 'thus te chu min kyang de'i gshis chu yin pas nam zhig zhu ba na chu'i ngo bor zhu 'gro ba bzhin du/ zhabrul ba'i yo lang sna tshogs kyis gtses te kun rtog rags pa sna tshogs pa mched pa 'di dag gi sgog gam gshis na 'od gsal yod pas de bla ma'i man ngag gisango sprad de mngon du gyur tshe 426

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/kun rtog thams cad 'od gsal gyi klong du thim 'gro bas 'od gsal dang rnam rtog gnyis gcig mngon du gyur pa na cig shos bag la zha 'gro ba srang mda'i mtho dman lta bu yin gsungs/ ༈ dhū ti'i rtsa 'khor thad/ rdzogs rim dus dhu ti'i nang kho nar 'char ba yin yang theg rtse sogs kyi lugs ltar na/ ye shes dang dwangs ma'i rlung rig gi cha re yod pa rnams rjen la bton nas mnyam par bzhag mthus sgru ti kho na min par lus thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul du 'char ba'i khyad par gyis rtsod ldan du chos kyi rgyal po'i mthus bde skyid khol bu dang / kha spyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi phun tshogs ltar rgya che la mtha' brtan pa'i khyad par lta bu yod ces rin po ches gsungs/ zhal rgyun du/ dus 'khor ltar na / stong seng tsam min par stong gzugs snang ba dang bcas pa 'char ba dang / de bzhin du 'dir yang stong gzugs dang zab pa'i phyogs kyi khyad par dang 'char ba'i gnas kyang rags pa'i rtsas gar khyab ye shes kyi rtsas khyab pa dang / rlung rags pa'i cha rnams ye rlung du shar nas 'od gsal mu mtha' med par 'char ba'i khyad par che'o gsungs/༈ rnam byang phyogs kyi gzhi byed lugs gzhan yang yod ces pa / gsar phyogs ltar na bla med lugs la/ mnyam bzhag tu 'od gsal de'i bden stong bsgom pa dang / rjes thob tu dag ma dag gi sgyu lus sgom pa ste chos gzugs gnyis kyi bsgrub gzhi'o/ /zhes gsung rgyun dang / phyi ma'i gnas lus sogs gsung rgyun las/ gong du bshad pa'i ye shes rang snang dang sems rang snang gnyis bstan pa'i phyi ma'o/ /phyi ma'i gnas lus sogs sems dang ye shes gang yang min pas rang snang dngos ma yin yang / snang srid dag mnyam du bstan pa rnams kyi dgongs don 427

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chos skor/gtan la dbab pa'i phyir thams cad rang snang gi phyogs su bsdus nasabastan pa'o/ /'das pa snang yang 'khor bar zhen pa zhes pa'i skabs/ dpe thag khra sbrul snang bzhin du 'das pa snang yang phyin ci log tu zhen pa ste/ thag khra'i spu nyag re re dang tshogs pa gang yang sprul du ma song bzhin dbang shes 'khrul ba la sprul snang bzhin du / ye shes dang de'i snang cha la yul dang yul can la rang rgyud par snang nas phyin ci log tu zhen pa ni sbyang bya'i gtso bo'o zhes dang / de la lhan skyes kun btags gnyis skabs / phar theg ltar grub mtha'i kun btags ma yin pa dang yin pa'i khyad par lta bu la go rgyu min par 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo'i dbyings la rmongs tsam gyi ma rtogs pa'i ma rig pa dang snang sems rang ngos nas grub par zhen pa'i log rtog gnyis las gtso bo phyi ma'o/ /zhal rgyun las/ gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di nyid kyi dper 'os pa 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag las med/ 'di la ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis yod/ 'dis yul gzigs tshul mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dper 'os pa 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag nyid yin par dus 'khor gyi spyi don mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad par yod cesagasungs/ skyed byed thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rnam pa gsum gyis thun mong dang mchog gi sems lnga sngon skyes sam da lta skyes pa'o/ /'dir sems lnga dag gi khyad par zhal lung sogs na gsal lo/ /tshogs spyod bzhin no zhes pa ni/ 'og sgo gtso bor ston pa'o/ /spyir thabs grol lam gyi khyab che chung ni grol lam gyi skabs su lam gyi khog shing mtshan nyid gsum gtso bor 428

spyi don rin wo mdzod lde'iwaṃn bris/bstan pa dang / thabs lam gyi skabs su rang gi dgos chos rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa tsam las ma bstan pas grol lam khyab che ba'o/ /zhes gsung rgyun las so/ /grol lam ni rin po che kostu bha sogs thad/ zin bris las/grol lam khe nyen chung la/ thabs lam ni khe nyen shin du che ste/ dper na gser 'gyur gyi rtsis stabs legs na srang gang gis lcags srang stong yud tsam gyis gser du bsgyur yang / nyes na lcags de tsam thal bar bsgyur ba ltar yin gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches/ thabs grol gyi lam de gnyis kyang thabs shes kyi byed pa tsam gtso che chung gi sgo nas bzhag gi gcig 3|sa la gcig 3|sa med pa ma yin la/ gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba la don gcig par shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / thabs lam rim gyis pa steng sgo dang cig char ba 'og sgo'i man ngag la brten par gsungs so/ / ༈ zin bris las/ rgyud 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya des thun mong gi lam gyis rgyud sbyang ba sngon du btang nas/ smin byed kyi dbang zhus/dbang srog dam tshig gis bzung ste lam rim gnyis la bslab/ de la sngon du lta ba gtan la phabs dgos/ de'ang rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba tsam kho na min par gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i yul gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam bzhag de la ji ltar gnad du bsnun tshul/ de ltar gnad du bsnun pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod par byas/ de nas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la dngos su slob pa ni rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin te/ bskyed rim sngon du btang ba'i rdzogs rim la thabs grol gnyis las/ rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa med par bzhag stobasakho nas rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon du 429

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/byas te/ de'i stobs kyis ye shes kyi snang cha gnyug ma'i rlung gis bskul te gzhi snang stong gzugs kyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar te lam du byed pa grol lam/ de ni rtogs dka' ba dang lam bur ba yin/ rtogs sla ba dang lam myur ba thabs lam ste / de la rang lus thabs ldan dang / gzhan lus thabs ldan gnyis kyi dang po ni snying ga'i mi shig pa sad pa lam gyi gnad yin pas/ de gtum mo'i me sbar te sad dgos de'i tshul ni rang nyid gsang chen rig gcig rdo rje 'chang ngam kun tu bzang po lta bur byas te/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun bcas/ spyi mgrin snying ga lte ba bzhi dang / lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du gtum mo a shad kyi gnas dang /de'i 'og tu sbor byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor te lus kyi rtsa 'khor drug gsal btab ste / steng rlung mnan 'og rlung drag tu 'then te rlung gnyis kha sbyor nas bzung / lte ba'i a thung zhes pa ngo bo khrag gi dwangs ma bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ rnam pa tsher ma rno sa nas bcad pa'i bcad kha gyen bstan lta bu/ reg bya tsha ba zhig gsal te/de la rig pa gtad de bzung nas ro rkyang du rgyu ba'i rlung sems thams cad dbu mar 'drong ba'i rkyen gyis a thung lhag par 'bar te spyi bo'i haṃ yig bskul bas byang sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba rim bzhin rtsa gnas rnams su yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba rgyas te mar me gsos na rang 'od mched nas 'ong ba ltar snying ga'i mi shig pa sogs dwangs ma stobs su gyur/ dwangs ma de dag gi lhan cig byed rkyen gyis ye shes kyi gdangs bskul te stong gzugs kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar ba la gzhi snang zer/ de la sku mthong thob gnyis yod/ snying rje sgyu ma man chad la lha sku yid ngor shar ba yin pas sku mthong ba dang / phyag rgya gcig pa man chad la dbu 430

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/ma'i nang du sgom stobs kyis mig dbang gsar du grub ste des dngos su mthong bas lha sku thob pa zer/ de 'dra'i gzhi snang de nyid slob lam rnams su rim gyis lam du byas te snang ba te rgya je che je bzang je dag je brtan du song ste slob pa mtha'i 'od gsal gyi tshe snang ba thams cad gnyug ma'i dbyings su thim pa'am zad de dbyings de'i ngang du song tshe rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam yin/ skabs der snang ba zad pa bzhin du rags lus 'od du dengs ba'am zad de skad cig gnyis pa nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan du bzhengs tshe rgyun mtha'i rnam grol lam zhes nam mkha' ma zhig bar du chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du sprul sku phrin las dang bcas pa 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams su spro ba ni mngon du gyur ba 'bras bu mthar thug gi dus yin no/ / ༈ mig dbang la bstan du yod pas lus snang ba 'dod khams/ dbang po gzugs can la bstan du yod cing mig dbang la bstan du med pas ngag phyed snang / dbang po gzugs can la spyir bstan du med pas yid mi snang tsha sogs/ gsung rgyun las/ yul dbang shes gsum skabs yul rags pa dang / dbang po de las phra ba/ rnam shes de las kyang phra bas na de dag la khams gsum zhes brjod de/ 'dod gzugs gzugs med rnams snga ma la ltos phyi ma dag phra ba'i khyad par dang mtshungs pas na de dag gi tha snyad sbyar ro/ /'khor lo gsum gnyis — sogs thad/ zin bris las/ spyi bo'i thig le haṃ yig gis mtshan pa nyid dbab ldog byed pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes gyi rten byed pas de'i gnas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor so gnyis la bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa'i thig le bza' bus longs spyod pa na ro drug myong ba'i rten 431

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/byed pas de'i gnas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor bcu drug la longs spyod kyi 'khor lo /snying ga'i mi shig pa'i thig le ni de la gnad du bsnun pas sad na rnam byang gi yon tan gyi chos mtha' dag gi rten byed pas de'i gnas rtsa 'khor brgyad la chos kyi 'khor lo dang / dang po mngal du chags pa na lte ba'i thig le chags te / de las phung khams rags pa 'phrul ba ste mched pas na de'i rtsa 'khor re bzhi la sprul ba'i 'khor lo ste zhes sbyar/ ༈ sa bon drug po rtsa 'dabs kyi sgabs sam mtha' na gnas so/ de yang snying khong stong gi dbus na rtsa'i dwangs ma rtsa 'dabs rgyas pa bldad pa 'dra ba brgyad yod pa rtsa bzhir 'dus te mdun gyi gsum chos nyid kyi rtsa ste skye ba med pa rang snang ba'i las byed pa/ g.yas kyi gcig ye shes kyi rtsa ste ye shes 'char ba'i las byed pa/ g.yon gyi rtsa gcig yon tan gyi rtsa ste mngon shes dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams snang ba'i las byed pa/ rgyab kyi gsum rang rgyud kyi rtsa ste shes pa rnams rmongs shing 'joms pa'i las byed do/ /rtsa de dag gi sbubs na 'od bzhi dang / de'i khrod na sbyang bya dang sbyong byed kyi sa bon rnam shes dang bcas pa rnams gnas te/ chos nyid kyi rtsa la 'od zlum po dkar po sbyang bya su dang tri/sbyong byed oṃ/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes so/ /ye shes kyi rtsa la 'od gru bzhi ser po sbyang bya a dang dṛ/ sbyong byed hūṃ/ yid kyi rnam shes/ yon tan gyi rtsa la 'od zla gam dmar po/ sbyang bya pre dang du/ sbyong byed skyu/ nyon mongasacan gyi yid/ rang rgyud kyi rtsa la 'od gru gsum dmar nag la sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa nyid dang bcas pa gnas so/ 'dir chos nyid dang ye shesakyi rtsa'i 'od dkar po dang ser por gnas pa dpe chung rang gnas kyi lugs te/ bi ma mi tra'i gsang thig las ni chos nyid 432

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/ser po dang ye shes mthing gar bshad do/ /de ltar snying ga'i dkyil 'bor rtsa chen bzhi dang ldan pa de'i nang na dwangs ma lnga'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi gnas pa'i dbus su ye shes snying po'i thig le stong gsal 'gags med bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs te/ nyi zla kha spyor gyi rgyud las/ tsitta rin chen gzhal yas na/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sku ni snang la rang bzhin med/ /che phra 'od gsal snying lngardzor bzhugs/ /zhes dang / brtags gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen por gnas/ /rtag pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po / / lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes dang / rim lnga las/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa ni/ /thig le gcig la 'gyur ba med/ /de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la/ /nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de la dwangs ma lnga ni gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /lnga po de'ang yum lnga ye shes lnga skur lngaraganas te/ rtsa'i dwangs ma ni 'byung ba sa ste yum spyan ma/ me long lta bu ye shes/ mngon byang gi sku'o/ /khrag gi dwangs ma chu ste ma ma gī/ mnyam nyid/ longs sku'o/ /me'i dwangs ma ni gos dkar mo / sor rtog rdo rje'i sku'o/ /rlung gi dwangs ma ni sgrol ma/ bya grub sprul sku'o/ /nam mkha'i dwangs ma ni dbyings phyug ma/ stong pa nyid/ chos kyi sku'o/ /ye shes snying po'i thig le ni/ rig pa'i dwangs ma sems nyid 'od gsal ba de/ yum lnga 'dus pa bya ba mo dang / ye shes lnga 'dus pa rang byung gi ye shes dang sku lnga 'dus pa bde chen gyi skur don gyis 'gyur zhing / der ma zad dwangs ma drug po'ang gnyis gnyis ro gcig tu 'jug pas phra ba'i sgo gsum mam rdo rje mi shig pa gsum du 'gyur te/ sa chu gnyis sku rdo rje/ me rlung gnyisagasung rdo rje/ mkha' sems gnyis 433

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/thugs rdo rje ste/ dpe chung rang gnas las/ mi shig ye shes thig le ni sogs ltar ro/ /zur 'debs nas so/ zhal rgyun las/ rdo rje me long gi lung don/ lus can sems can kun gyi snying la gnas pa'i ye shes rgyu rkyen las 'das rang byung ye shes zag med kyi rang bzhin gzugs kyi skad dod ru pa rang bzhin la go ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / rlung khams sems mi shig pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i bde chen nam mkha' lta bu srid zhir mi gnas chos sku'i rang bzhin can no/ /zhes dang / dpe chung rang gnas lung don/ gcig dang du ma'i spros pa thams cad las 'das pa/ sna tshogs su snang yang ngo bo sgra rtog gis ji bzhin brjod du med pa'o/ /sku sgrub byed kyi las bsags pa rnams oṃ gyi steng du gsog pa dang / zhes pa'i thad/ nye dwangs ni 'di dag la rags pa pha ma'i khu khrag gi cha dang las rlung dang / der brten bag chags kyis bgo gzhi kun gzhi dang / ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyi rlung khams sems bcas dang gnyis 'dod dgos pa 'dra ste/ kun rtog gis lha bsgom pa sogs kyis bag chags 'dzin pa'i phyir dang / ye shes kyi cha'i stong gzugs snang ba'i nus pa 'dzin pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so/ /༈ brda bzhi dang phyag rgya bzhi'i thad/ gsung rgyun las/ brda bzhi ni sa ma ya st+waṃḥdus la bab ces yum gyis bskul/ sa ma ya hoXdus yin no zhes lan sbyin/slar yang rā ga ya lhakhyabadag chagasasozhes bskul/ rā ga yā mi'i chagasapar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan sbyin no/ /༈ phyag rgya bzhis snyoms par zhugs pa ni/ dza zhes pas lus kyi cha rnams regahūṃ zhes pas lag pa dang brla 'khyud/ beḥzhes pa'i mkha' gsang dam du sprad/434

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/hoXzhes yab kyi gsor yum gyis bskyod pa la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'gugs pa/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba 'ching ba yan lag phan tshun sdom pa bsdam pa/ yab yum bde bas tshim pa myos pa ste rags pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ dmar cha gyen du drangs ba 'gugs pa/ rlung gi byed bcing gi stobs kyis gcun pa 'ching ba/ thig le phyir mi ldog pa bsdam pa/ yab yum kyi gsang ba'i rnam shes bde bas tshim pa myos paste phra ba'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /lhan skyes gnyis 'brel ba zhes pa rten gyi sgo nas yab yum kyi lhan skyes gnyis/ brten nga/'i sgo nas yas babs dang mas brtan gyi lhan skyes gnyis so/ /'jog tshul khyad par can gzhan gsungs so/ zhes pa'i thad du/ zhal lung du/ lam rim las 'di yang lam sgrub sbyor ba yi/ /zhes pas lam gyi/ dus kyi dang / bsgrub pa'i dus kyi dang / sbyor ba'i dus kyi bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi'o/ /dang po ni lta ba rtogs nas stong chen dang kun ting la gnas pa ni bsnyen pa/ phyag rgya gcig spro ni nye bsnyen/ yo byad lngas tshogs sgrub pa ni sgrub pa/ de 'bras zag med kyi rig 'dzin thob ma rag pa ni sgrub chen te/ lam rim las/ byang chub sems rtogs 'grub pa ni / / bsnyen pa'i dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ /sems chos snying rje man chad do/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /de phyir gcig dang spros pa'o/ /sgrub pa nyid ni bar chad med/ /dus kyi tshogs mtha' sgrub chen no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni zla ba gcig la sgrub pa rdzogs pa ma yin pas zla drug la sogs pa ci tsam byed pa la cha brtsi ba yin mod kyi/ 'o na 'dir zla ba gcig lta bu la dper byas te brtsi na/ de las/ zla phyed phyed zhal nye bsnyen pa/ /lha gsal 'phro 'dus 435

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/snang du rung / /bco lnga mar phyed sgrub pa ste/ /'phro 'du bsnol mas bsgrub par bya/ /zhag grangs tshang nas rtags byung na/ /dngos grub bzlas kyang sgrub chen no/ /zhes pa'i cha rkyen rnams tshang nas sgrub pa la 'jug par ma thog pa ni bsnyen pa/ zhugs nas zla ba phyed yan chad ni nye bsnyen/ tha ma'i zhag gcig ma gtogs pa'i phyed man chad ni sgrub pa/ nub tha ma dngos grub len pa ni sgrub pa chen po ste/ sgrub byang las/ rim pa shom dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ /bsnyen pa zhes su brjod pa yin/ /gsang sgor zhugs nasabyin ldan pa/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa zhes su brjod/ /gang yang bar chad mi g.yel bar/ /dam pa'i gzhung gnyis 'dzin pa na/ /sgrub pa zhes subarjod pa yin/ /rnal 'byor drod kyi rtsal 'kho ba/ /sgrub pa rpā po de brjod do/ /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ yum btsal te chas su zhugs pa ni bsnyen pa/ de byin gyis brlabs pa nye bsnyen/ rol nas dbab bzung gi dgongs pa ni sgrub pa/ nyi zla rdo rje'i lces len pa te ldog bkram gyi dgongs pa ni sgrub chen te/ lag len sbyor mchod bzhin no/ /de'ang lam rim las/ gsum pa mchod pa'i skabs bzhin shes zhes so/ /spang nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa — sogs thad/ gsung rgyun las/spang zhes pa mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa spang ba dang / rdo rje zhes pa skyil krung ste de la gsum/ lus rdo rje skyil krung ni yab yum mnyam par spyor ba'o/ /rtsa rdo rje skyil krung ni yum gyi dbu ma'i mar sna yab kyi dbu mar drangs te sad par byas pa'o/ /rlung rdo rje skyil krung ni/ yum gyi dbu ma'i rlung yab kyi dbu mar drangs ba dang /khams rdo rje skyil krung ni/ thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa'o/ /rin po ches/ thal rgyud las/ spang nas rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa/ /dgug dang bsdam pa ma shes na/ /436

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/zhes thabs lam 'og sgo'i skabs rtsa 'ching ba gal che gsungs pa 'di 'bor mi nyan/ zhes gsungs so/ / ༈ 'di la dang 'dis rtog pa zhes pa ni/ rnam rtog 'dis yul du gyur pa'am rtog pa des bzhag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched la 'di la dang / rnam rtog 'dis rtog par byed pas na 'dis rtog pa zhes so/ /snga ma yul la yul can gyi ming gis btags pa'o/ / ༈ rtogs pa shin tu myur ba ni/rnam byang gi dbang po lnga'i nang nas gtso bor shes rab kyis 'jug pa ches myur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mtshan nyid gsum gyi bar gzhan gyis ma chod par yun shin tu thung ba la rtogs sgom mthar phyin par byed pa la cig char ba zhes brjod pa yin gyi/deli rgyud kyi mtshan nyid gsum gyi snga phyi'i rim pa med pa min te 'gal me'i 'khor lo bzhin no/ /sbyang rno rang rno sogs zhal lung na gsal bas ma bris/ gtan tshigs kyi sna rtse tsam zhes pa rtags sgrub sogs rgyas par bkod pa la mi ltos par sbyor ba gcig bkod pa tsam gyis mngon sum du rtogs pa la go dgos gsungs/ 'dir thun min gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed kyang lta ba'i phyogs nas 'jog zhes pa'i thad/ zin bris las/ sngar gzhi rgyud skabs lugs 'dir sems de dag gi gnad gsang rdo rje'i ye shes 'di kho na byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi snying por bzhed pas byang chub kyi sems zhes bya gsungs pa de'o/ /snying po zhes pa de dngos la byed kyi sa bon lta bu la go rgyu min gsungs/ yang zhal rgyun du/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtogs pa'i rang lugs thun min gyi sems bskyed dang mnyam bzhag ye shes 'od gsal ba nyid brtse ba'i snying rje'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pas 437

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/rjes thob tu rkyen phra mos bskul ba'i sgo nas 'gro kun gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'brul rtog glo bur ba bsal nas bdag gis sems can ched du sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa rang shugs la 'ong ba ni thun mong sems bskyed kyang tshang bar gsungs so/ /gsung rgyun las/ 'dir thun min gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed ces pa/ snang cha sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rtogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ma dag pa'i zhen snang gtan la phab pas chos nyid gtan la pheb par 'gyur ba'i skabs/ sgyu 'phrul 'di'i skabs kyi snang zhen gcod lugs ni/ rin po ches gter chen la gsungs pa/ dpe nyi ma sprin gyis bsgrib pa'i skabs drod dang ldan pa yin kyang /sgrib byed sprin gyi dbang gis 'od zer drod ldan du mi 'char ba yin la/ sprin dang bral tshe 'od zer mtha' dag drod dang ldan par dngos su 'char la/ de yang sngar drod med gsar du drod dang ldan par song ba min par tha snyad kyi yin tshul gsal ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'char gzhi 'od gsal ba'i rig pa nyid tshogasabargyad glo bur ba'i sprin gyis bsgrib tshe/ sems kun gyi gshis ye shes yin par mi snang bar ma dag rang rgyud par snang zhing zhen la/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas snying dbus kyi 'od gsal sad nas mngon du gyur tshe/ de'i ngor sems thams cad 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'chang ba ni/dpe gser gling du phyin pa lta bu yin la/ 'di dus yul can thams cad ye shes 'ba' zhig tu yin par shar ba ni/ sngar ye shes min pa gsar du ye shes su song ba min par gnasalugs ji bzhin pa nyid mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /rig pa sad 438

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/stobs kyis yul can thams cad ye shes su shar/ yul yang ye shes kyi ngor snang pas yul gyi steng na ma dag pa bsal rgyu med par thams cad dag pa 'ba' zhig las med pa myong pas grub pa yin no/ /zhen snang ni rjes thob rgya yan pa'i ngor snang sems rang rgyud pa 'khrul rtog tu snang ba 'di tsam las gzhan med pas/ ngo shes ma shes tsam mam rig pa sad ma sad tsam mo zhes gsung rgyun bslu med do/ /༈ mi pham rin po'i ches/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad chos can dang / de'i rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ye shes gnyis ni/ gcig tha dad gang du'ang khas blang bya min par/dgongs 'grel las/ 'du byed khams dang don dam mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i chos nyid de/ /gcig dang tha dad du yang gang rtog pa/ /de dag tshul min lta la zhugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung bzhin klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs la/ de phyir de gnyis tha snyad du gcig ma yin te/ sems rtogs pa tsam gyis sems kyi chos nyid ye shes mi rtogs pa dang / chos can dang chos nyid yin pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ don dam par tha dad min te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes yin pas/ ye shes rtogs dus sems kyang de las tha dad du ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang / ye shes rtogs tshe sems rang grol du 'char ba sogs kyi phyir na'o/ /zhes so/ /'di thad/ bla ma 'jigs 'od nyid kyi zhal rgyun las/ gsung sgros thun min ltar na/ye shes rang dbang gi snang ba chos can/ dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu gnas pa yin te/ de'i snang cha la ma dag pa'i snang ba ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang /dpal sprul gsung rgyun las/ snang ba 'di chos can/ lha yin te/ ye shes rang snang 439

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/yin pa'i phyir/ 'di skabs kyi lha ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid yin la / lha de nyid tshogs brgyad kyi rnam par bzhengs pa'i ye shes rang snang gi cha yin pa'i phyir zhes par go dgos zhes dang / ༈ rdzogs chen lugs la snang ba thams cad kyi chos nyid rig stong 'dus ma byas pa de 'bras bu yongs dag lha'i ngo bor dang po ngo shes/ bar du yang yang bskyangs bas rtsal rdzogs pa'i thabs la slob cing / mthar brtan pa thob tshe sgom stobs kyis snang ba lhar sgrub pa'am shar ba yin no/ /bshad pa mang pos snang ba lhar mi 'grub kyi/ dang po sems dang rig pa gnyis su phye nasarig pa rkyang ded du bskyangs ba ni snang ba ltar grub pa'i sgo yin/bar du snang lugs 'khrul ba cung zad log nas sems rig gnyis med chu dang rlabs ltar mthong nas sems rig gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrogs lhod nas rtsal gyi 'char sgo la dgag sgrub mi dgos par gu yangs la blo bde ba'i dbyings kyi nam mkha' la rig pa'i mkha' lding g.yo ba na snang ba lhar 'grub pa'i mgo rtsom pa yang yin/ mthar brtan pa thob pa mthar thug pa na gser gling du sa rdo phal ba btsal kyang mi rnyed pa sems rig chu dang rlabs ltar rtogs par ma zad snang sems kyang de ltar rtogs pa dang gnas lugs dang snang lugs ma bu 'phrod de snang lugs kyi 'khrul cha dbyings su zad pa na slob lam gyi snang ba lhar sgrub mthar༄ga yin zhing /mthar rig pa dbyings su 'khyil/ rig gdangs sku dang zhing khams su smin/ rig rtsal rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su grol ba na snang ba lhar grub pa bla na med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zin bris las/ thag khra sbrul du snang ba chosacan/ji ltar snang ba ltar gyi sbrul gyis gdod nas stong ste/ khyod yul mi gsal ba 440

spyi don rin rṣa mdzod lde'i zin bris/sogs kyi rkyen las snang gzhi thag pa la sprul du bzung ba'i snang ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ don ni log rtog 'khrul ba'i dmigs yul du gyur ba'i ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched chos can/ ji ltar snang ba ltar grub pas gdod nas sam ye nas stong ste/ khyod gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi snang ba las phyir gol te ma rig pa mched phyin chad kyi snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa zhal rgyun yin zhes dang / ston pa chos longs rdo rje mngon byang gi sku bzhi dang 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho sogs bzhi po rnams ni ldog chas phye la/ sku de dag rang rang gi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i stobs kyis/ 'khor rnams kyi sku de dang cha 'dra ba'i rtogs pa khyad par can thob pas/ rang rang gi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa la gsung gis brda sprad pa'i tha snyad sbyar ba yin/ chos sku'i chos thams cad skye ba med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas 'khor gyis kyang de dang cha 'dra ba rtogs pa dang / longs sku'i sku gsum ngo bo dbyer med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pas me long la pra phab pa ltar longs sku mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud kyis sgrib pa phra mo ngos zin pa dang / rdo rje'i skus sku gsum ngo bo dbyer med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas 'khor rnams lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med gyi don dang / mngon byang gis sku lnga ye shes lnga'i ldog cha tha dad pa la dgongs pa gtad pas 'khor rnams spros pa mtha' dag gi sbub las grol ba'i 'od gsal mngon sum du rtogs gsungs/ gsung rgyun las/longs skus smin pa zhes pa rgyun mtha' ba des mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud kyi dri ma ngos zin no/ /sprul skus mos pa zhes pa mos spyod pa rnams la'o/ /zhes dang / sku gsum dbyer 441

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/med kyi cha nas dang / sku gsum gyi ldog cha ma 'dres pa'i cha nas rdo rje dang mngon byang gi sku'o/ /zin bris las/ bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dpal sprul lo/ /spyir dbang rnon ni rtags sam gtan tshigs tsam la brten pa'i shes rab kyi grol ba dang / 'dir dngos lnga sogs kyis ye shes mtshon nas rtogs pas grol tshul gnyis dbyibs mtshungs su yod pas dngos lnga sogs gtan tshigs mtshan nyid pa dang 'dra ba las btags te/ zhes so/ /gsung rgyun las/ bzhed pa gnyis po gang la'ang 'thad mi 'thad kyai cha gnyis zhes pa/ zhen snang med ces pa mi 'thad de shes sgrib phra mo yod pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs min zhes pa 'thad ldan no/ /zhen snang bcad rgyu yod ces pa 'thad/ gtan tshigs dngos yin gsungs pa mi 'thad de gtan tshigs btags pa ba yin no/ /zhes dang / skye med mtshon pa zhes pa nam mkha' mthong ba tsam gyis chos rnams skye med du rtogs pa dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan gyi dri ma mthong ba tsam gyis rang rgyud kyi dri ma ngos zin pa dang / nyi ma'i snying po mthong ba tsam gyis gsal ba'i ye shes mngon sum rtogs pa dang /brag cha thos pa tsam gyis grags stong dbyer med kyi don rtogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshangs dbyangs gcig thos pa'i tshe na rang rang gi mos pa shes nus pa bzhin dngos po gcig nyid mthong ba'i tshe na dgongs don sna tshogs shes nus so/ /ldem dgongs brda'i tshigs sogs thad zhal rgyun du khams gsum gyi srog bcad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i nang du rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba la go ba dang / chos thams cad brag cha lta bu'o/ /nyin par gyi snang ba nyi ma lasagazhan du ma gyur pa'o/ /zhes pa dag longs sku'i dang / dbyer med dang / mngon byang gi gsung gi mtshan 442

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i thin bris/gzhir bzhag gsungs/ tshig don mthun pa'i gtan tshigs kyi skabs su sgra mi 'gal zhes pa'i don ni/ ci yang min pa dang / yin pa gnyis tshig 'gal ba ltar ma yin pa la go ba las/ gzhan tshig don mi mthun pa ni rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos 'gal ba la go na 'gal rtags mtshan nyid par 'gyur bas/ tshig don mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag bzhag tu med pas skurdzo/ / ༈ gtan tshigs thad mi pham rin po ches mdzad pa'i man ngag lta phreng gi mchan 'grel nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ rgyu gcig par rtogs pa dang / yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang /byin gyi rlabs kyis rtogs pa dang / mngon sum par rtogs pa'o/ /de yang rtogs pa bzhi 'di la rim cig char gnyis kyi bshad pa 'byung yang 'dir rdzogs pa chen po rang byung gi ye shes thig le nyag gcig tu gtan la 'bebs pas cig char ba ltar du bshad de/ de la rgyu ste rang bzhin nam gzhi gcig par rtogs pa ni chos thams cad don dam par ma skyes pas zhes ma skyes pa'i rang bzhin du so so ma yin pa dang / kun rdzob tu snang ba bden stong sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du so so ma yin pa ni theg pa chen po thun mong du grags pa dang / ma skyes pa nyid ma skyes bzhin du chu zla ltar sgyu ma dag sna tshogs su snang zhing rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa dang / sgyu ma ltar snang ba nyid snang bzhin du'ang ngo bo med de ma skyes pas na kun rdzob dang don dam par dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug rang byung gi ye shesargyu gcig par rtogs pa ni lung zab mo las grags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /mdor na rang byung ye shes byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni snang stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ 'khor 'das thams cad de'i tshul gcig las mi 'da' ba ni 443

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosaskor/rgyu gcig pa'o/ /yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa ni/ de lta bu'i snang stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin de nyid kyang gdod ma nas sku gsung thugs 'bras bu'i chos su sangs rgyas par bstan pa ste/ de la chos thams cad ma skyes pa ni a yis mtshon te gsung gi rang bzhin/ ma skyes pa nyid sgyu mar snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa ni o yis mtshon te sku'i rang bzhin/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rig pa sgyu ma'i ye shes mtha' dbus med pa ni oṃ gyis mtshon te thugs kyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa'o/ /de yang gdod nas snang stong zung 'jug gi ye shes de la bsal bzhag gi bri gang nam yang med cing de nyid rang bzhin rnam par dag pas 'khor ba ye sangs chen pe rdzoyin la/de nyid kyi rol ba ni gdod nas dkyil 'khor gsum du gnas pa yin par ni yig 'bru'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'o/ /byin gyi rlabs kyis rtogs pa ni/ rtogs pa rnams pa gnyis po de'i mthu dang byin rlabs shes pa ste/ dper na ras dkar po la dmar po byin gyis rlobs pa'i mthu btsod la yod pa bzhin du/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs pa'i mthu yang rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul gyi mthus byin gyis rlobs par shes shing rtogs pa'o/ /de la chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin mod kyi rtogs pa gnyis dang mi ldan pa rnams la/ des phan 'dogs par mi 'gyur la/ de gnyis dang ldan na ni phan thog par snang bar 'gyur bas/ rtogs pa gnyis kyi mthus chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs pa ltar snang bar 'gyur bas byin gyis rlobs par rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon sum par rtogs pa ni/ spyir dbang po mngon sum sogs yod kyang 'dir shes rab kyi dbang po'i mngon sum ste/ de yang so sor 444

spyi don rin chen mdzod lde'i zin bris/rtog pa'i shes rab nyid la go bar bya ste/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par gnas pa de yang yin zhes pa'i lung dang bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang 'gal ba'ang ma yin ste/ dper na bsreg bcad brdar bas gser yin min zon yod med gser bzang ngan shes pa bzhin du/ lung gis spyi la mi 'khrul/ lung la drang nges ldem dgongs sna tshogs pa la bla ma'i man ngag gis de'i skyon bsal bas yid ches/ lung dang man ngag yod kyang tshig tsam gyis sgra phyir 'brang pas blo'i gting du nyams su ma lon pa yang yod pas/ lung dang man ngag gis tshig tsam la brten pa'ang ma yin par so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bam rang gi rig pas blo'i gting du yid ches pas mngon sum du rtogs pa'o/ /zhes 'dis ni lung gi don spyi phyin ci ma log par shes par 'gyur la/ man ngag gis lung gi dgongs pa gzhan du 'dren pa gcod cing / shes rab kyis mngon sum du rtogs pas thos pa tsam la sogs pa nyid du zhen pa sel zhing gcod par byed pa yin no/ /de ltar lam gyis yid ches pa ni/ rtogs pa rnam bzhi'i don de nyid shes shing rig pa nyid rnal 'byor ba'i lam ste/ de yang mtshan nyid theg par rgyu sngon du bsgrub pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid phyis nam zhig na 'byung ba'i dus la stos pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ da lta nyid du shes rab kyi dbang pos rang gis mngon sum du rtogs shing yid ches pa'o/ /zhes dang / rin po ches/ yongs su dag pa'i lha sku thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon ni gsung sngags kyi yi ge ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad ming tsam la gnas pa la gtug nas le'u bzhi par rgyas bshad mdzad/ phung sogs cir snang thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon ni chos kyi dbyings sam sems kyi gnyug ma'i khams te 'dir 'od gsal 445

gsang snying dang 'brel ba'i chosasgor/bsam mi khyab bam mi rtog pa'am spros pa med pa'i bzhugs tshul gyi cha'o/ /de nyid ni yid skyobs pa'i man tra thams cad kyi mthar thug ste/ phyag rdor dbang bskur du chos kyi dbyings la lha sngags phyag rgya sogs mang por brtags nasadangos grub kyi don byed par gsungs pa lta bu/ de glo bur ba'i spros pas stong pa'am dag pa yin cing / gang snang thams cad de'i ngang las mched pa ni snang ba thams cad ka nas dag pa'am mched gzhi'i sa bon mthar thug nas dag pa dang gdod nas dag pa'o/ /de'i phyir dbyings de ni sa bon gyi sngags de a/ de'i rnam 'gyur rang snang ris med sngags kyisamig bsgyur ba'i rang snang gi sgyu ma lta bur mched pa ni lha'i sku ste os mtshon/ de ltar dbyings dang / de nyid snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba thams cad sngags bla med kyi rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi dkyil 'khor gcig tu'am rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku gsung ngam lha sngags kyi yo lang kho nar gnas pa de rtogs byed kyi thugs ni 'od gsal rang gi mkhyen cha'am rig pa'i cha ste/ des rtogs tshul yang dbyings dang yul snang gnyis char rig cha nyid las mi gzhan par mngon du gyur nas rtogs bya gnyis ka rtogs byed kyi klong du rdzogs pa a o gnyis char oṃ la rdzogs pa lta bu'o/ /oṃ gyi don ni/ gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /snang ba thams cad rang snang yin/ /ye shes rig pa ngo mtshar che dang gcig red/ rtogs dus snang rig dbyings gsum khyab brdal du 'dres nas mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal du 'gyur bar ma zad dbyings ma rtogs/ rang snang snod bcud rgyud gsum rang rgyud par zhen pa'i dus nyid nas shes pas gar khyab rig pa'i bdag nyid gcig pu'i 446
